ref: Haldr 在Gilligan基金会定期编制的"银河系中最令人不愉快的有人居住的行星"官方名单中排名相当靠前。事实上，即使是最乐观的太空旅行者也很难找到一个很好的理由来解释为什么有人想来Haldr ，更不用说留在那里了。事实证明，戴瓦德(Dvaered)最高司令部有这样的原因:Haldr 是戴瓦德(Dvaered)新兵的训练场。尽管许多即将入伍的士兵在Haldr 的放射性表面发现死亡，但那些幸存下来的人确实是坚强的战士。

src: The first Soromid bioships were grown on Sorom itself, and it was in those ships that the Soromid spread through the galaxy. But Sorom is no more. Nowadays, most Soromid ships are grown here, on Heronus. The planet's gravitic and atmospheric properties make it ideal for raising ships in all kinds of sizes and shapes. A carrier class vessel can reach maturity in as few as four cycles.
ref: 最初的索洛米德(Soromid)生物飞船是在Sorom本土培育的，索洛米德(Soromid)人正是驾驶这些飞船在银河系中扩张。但Sorom已不复存在。如今，大多数索洛米德(Soromid)飞船都在Heronus上培育。该行星的重力和大气特性使其成为培育各种尺寸和形状飞船的理想场所。一艘航母级飞船最快只需四个周期就能发育成熟。

src: Heronus Nidus is a military base directly tied to Heronus below. Its primary duty is to protect the planet, because it is vital to the Soromid fleet. If Heronus were to cease producing new ships, the Soromid would suffer a tremendous blow to their military capabilities. Needless to say, Heronus Nidus is one of the most heavily armed stations in Soromid space.
ref: Heronus Nidus是一个与下面的Heronus 直接相连的军事基地。它的主要职责是保护地球，因为它对索洛米德(Soromid)舰队至关重要。如果Heronus停止生产新船，索洛米德(Soromid)号的军事能力将遭受巨大打击。不用说，Heronus Nidus是索洛米德(Soromid)太空中最全副武装的空间站之一。

src: Hikatalat used to be a resource world, before the rise of the Empire. But over time the colony was deemed to be unprofitable, and operations ceased. The world is still inhabited today, but its only value now lies in territorial control for Dvaered Warlords. The population is poor and lives in bad circumstances. There's nothing much to do here for offworlders.
ref: Hikatalat 在帝国崛起之前曾是一个资源世界。但随着时间的推移，该殖民地被认为无利可图而停止运营。这个世界至今仍有人居住，但其唯一价值现在在于为戴瓦德(Dvaered)军阀提供领土控制。人口贫困且生活条件恶劣，外界人在这里无事可做。

src: This agristation is the first in a series of stations built by House Za'lek to mimic the successful INSS system in the Empire. Because there are so many Za'lek worlds that are incapable of supporting themselves without outside assistance, the stations become mandatory to feed the people there. Unlike its successors, HZNSS-1 has a research centre with a large conservatory containing a diversity of modified and rare plants which attracts many curious civilians from the area around.
ref: 这个农业站是Za ' lek家族为模仿帝国成功的INSS系统而建造的一系列空间站中的第一个。因为有太多的扎列克(Za'lek)世界没有外界的帮助就无法养活自己，所以空间站就成了强制性的，必须养活那里的人。与它的后继者不同，HZNSS-1有一个研究中心，里面有一个大型温室，里面有各种各样的改良和稀有植物，吸引了周围地区许多好奇的平民。

src: Jomos' bar is a luxury bar first and foremost. It is usually the first place incoming tourists visit after disembarking their transport, and the local authorities want to make them feel welcome. There is music, the windows let in a lot of sunshine, and the interior is adorned with plants and small pieces of art. For regular spacers, however, this is of little use, as they are typically here on business, not for fun.
ref: Jomo的酒吧首先是一家豪华酒吧。这通常是入境游客下船后第一个参观的地方，当地政府希望让他们感到受欢迎。有音乐，窗户让大量阳光进来，室内装饰着植物和小艺术品。然而，对于普通的太空人来说，这几乎没有什么用处，因为他们通常是来这里出差的，而不是为了娱乐。

src: Volcanic A class planets aren't usually prime candidates for colonization. But sometimes it can be advantageous for an industry to put a factory or two on a planet like Kaulas. Geothermal energy is available in plentiful supply, and some select spots on the planet's surface are stable enough to set up a natural furnace for producing things that require a lot of heat in their production process.
ref: 火山A级行星通常不是殖民的主要候选者。但有时，对一个行业来说，在Kaulas这样的星球上建一两家工厂可能是有利的。地热能供应充足，地球表面的一些精选地点足够稳定，可以建立一个天然熔炉来生产在生产过程中需要大量热量的东西。

src: Koga has a highly active crust, and many describe the surface as being a reasonable facsimile of hell. They may not be too far off the mark, as lava flows and sudden rumbles from the earth are quite common. Although most of the planet is unsuitable for construction, there is a small area at the south pole that is reasonably stable, by Koga standards, allowing for people to live.
ref: Koga 有一个高度活跃的地壳，许多人将其表面描述为合理的地狱复制品。它们可能不会偏离目标太远，因为熔岩流动和地球上突然发出的隆隆声相当常见。尽管地球上的大部分地区不适合建造，但按照古贺的标准，南极有一小块区域相当稳定，可以让人们居住。

src: From space, Mendez looks like a dustball. Its surface is mostly brown and the only visible clouds are dust storms. It is therefore rather surprising that the Soromid use this planet as a major food growing world. The Soromid have developed a kind of crop that will grow in the harsh conditions of Mendez. Unfortunately, the leaves are brown and tough and, while nutritious, don't taste very good.
ref: 从太空上看，Mendez看起来像个尘球。它的表面大部分是棕色的，唯一可见的云层是沙尘暴。因此，索洛米德(Soromid)人将这个星球作为一个主要的粮食种植世界，这是相当令人惊讶的。索洛米德(Soromid)人已经培育出一种可以在Mendez恶劣条件下生长的作物。不幸的是，树叶是棕色的，坚硬的，虽然有营养，但味道不是很好。

src: New Europe was once a prosperous M-class world located on the major trade route between Sirius space and Sol. With abundant crop yields and a stable and agreeable climate, many people considered it to be very close to the old less developed Earth. When the Incident occurred, New Europe was outside the explosive barrier and survived unscathed. However, over time, the Nebula began to encroach on the territory, and in a mere 20 cycles was able to block out a significant amount of light and begin to strip the atmosphere off the planet. Although the planet is not yet completely barren and unlivable, it seems like the process is irreversible, leading to the population trying to evacuate and leave the planet towards better territories. Although there is still a fair number of people left, all people of importance to the Sirius have long since left, leaving only the new Nebula refugees.
ref: 新欧洲曾经是一个繁荣的M级世界，位于天狼星空间和索尔之间的主要贸易路线上。由于作物丰产，气候稳定宜人，许多人认为它离古老的欠发达地球很近。事件发生时，新欧洲处于爆炸屏障外，毫发无损。然而，随着时间的推移，星云开始侵占这片领土，在短短20个周期内，就能够阻挡大量的光线，并开始将大气层从行星上剥离。虽然地球还不是完全贫瘠和不适合居住，但这一过程似乎是不可逆转的，导致人们试图疏散，并离开地球前往更好的领土。虽然仍然有相当数量的人离开，但天狼星上所有重要的人早已离开，只剩下新的星云难民。

src: Nonuri is a world with an under-developed economy, even by Frontier standards. It barely manages to keep itself from going bankrupt. The people who live here stay mainly out of a sense of belonging, a feeling that Nonuri is their birthright. In fact, Nonuri was colonized by the colony ship Wendigo, which makes Nonuri one of the oldest extrasolar human settlements. Unfortunately for the locals, most of the galaxy doesn't care quite as much as they do. Recently, Nonuri has seen an increase in population from Nebula refugees that were not able to make it to Empire or Dvaered territories.
ref: Nonuri 即使以边疆的标准来看也是一个经济欠发达的世界。它勉强维持自身不破产。住在这里的人们留下主要是出于归属感，认为Nonuri 是他们与生俱来的权利。事实上，Nonuri 里是由殖民船温迪戈建立的，这使Nonuri 成为最古老的系外人类定居点之一。对当地人来说不幸的是，银河系大多数地方并不像他们那样在意。最近，Nonuri 接收了更多未能抵达帝国或戴瓦德(Dvaered)领土的星云难民。

src: Petaat can be called a civilian Dvaered world, if you're feeling nice. Fact is that people live here, and a Dvaered Warlord controls the local government. But that's about as far as it goes. Petaat is a very unpleasant world, its surface constantly plagued by dust storms and its soil unfit for crop growing. The people living here only do so because they don't have the means to leave.
ref: Petaat 可以被称作一个民用戴瓦德(Dvaered)世界——如果你愿意说得好听些。事实是这里居住着人类，且由戴瓦德(Dvaered)军阀控制着当地政府，但仅此而已。Petaat 是个环境恶劣的星球，地表常年遭受沙尘暴侵袭，土壤也不适宜作物种植。居住于此的人们仅仅是因为没有离开的手段才留在此地。

src: Racheka is a relatively young Sirius colony. Where most Sirius planets are converted planets that once belonged to another faction, Racheka was actually established by Sirius colonists a considerable time after Sirichana settled on Mutris. Perhaps for this reason the Sirian religion can be felt very strongly here, as there are no remnants of other cultures mingling in the lives of the population.
ref: Racheka是天狼星势力较新的殖民地。与多数由其他势力行星改造而来的天狼星星球不同，拉切卡是在天狼星人(Sirii)定居穆特里斯(Mutris)相当长时间后，才由天狼星殖民者建立的。或许正因如此，这里能感受到格外强烈的天狼星宗教氛围——居民生活中完全没有其他文化的残留痕迹。

src: It is said that when the first colonist ship landed here, its captain took a look outside and muttered to himself: "what a ruin of a planet". His cabin crew overheard, and the word stuck. Today, the planet is officially known as Ruin on all publicly sold star maps. While the planet has been significantly developed since its colonization, it is hard to say that it is an interesting or exciting world.
ref: 传说首批殖民飞船降落此地时，舰长望着舷窗外喃喃自语：'真是个废墟般的星球'。这句话被船员们无意听闻后竟广为流传。如今在所有公开销售的星图上，该行星的正式名称就是'废墟星(Ruin)'。尽管经过多年殖民开发，这颗星球依然难以称得上有什么迷人之处。

src: Rulk'ar is a mining-world with a strong presence of Za'lek universities thanks to its rather isolated nature aesthetic view. It is a centre of terraforming research, turning an already inhabitable planet into a full class-M world. Many burnt out Za'lek researchers come here to get more in touch with nature and get away from the intense research schedules they have back at their research centres, and quite a few never return.
ref: Rulk'ar因其与世隔绝的自然美学景观而成为拥有扎列克(Za'lek)大学强势存在的矿业世界。这里是地形改造研究中心，将本已适宜居住的星球改造成完全的M级世界。许多精疲力竭的扎列克(Za'lek)研究员来此亲近自然，逃离研究中心的紧张日程，其中不少人再也没有回去。

src: This world is teeming with volcanoes and rivers of lava, punctuated with frequent earthquakes and acid rains. It is possibly one of the most hostile environments to be found in space. So naturally, there is a sizable presence of scientists and geologists who find it to be a treasure trove. The Za'lek authorities use it as a hostile environment training centre as well.
ref: 这个世界遍布火山和熔岩河流，频繁发生地震和酸雨。可能是太空中环境最恶劣的星球之一。自然，这里聚集了大量视其为宝藏的科学家和地质学家。扎列克(Za'lek)当局也将其用作恶劣环境训练中心。

src: Sirius Monastery is the primary military hub of the Sirius army. It serves as the gatekeeper for Aesir, making sure no threats will ever reach Mutris. The station has hundreds of hangars in all sizes, allowing a full contingent to be stationed and ready at all times. Large meditation chambers also ensure that the psychic powers of the military are always ready to be deployed.
ref: 天狼星Monastery是天狼星军队的主要军事枢纽。它充当了艾瑟尔的守门人，确保穆特里斯(Mutris)永远不会受到威胁。空间站有数百个大小不一的机库，使一支完整的特遣队能够随时驻扎并做好准备。大型冥想室还确保军队的通灵力量随时可以部署。

src: Since well-to-do Dvaereds have laid complete claim to Varia's surface, all industrial and military enterprises have been moved offworld to Stalwart Citadel. While two-thirds of the station's decks are in use by major Dvaered corporations, there is enough space left for a respectable military wing. In fact, Stalwart Citadel features as the base of most military operations in the surrounding systems.
ref: 由于富裕的戴瓦德(Dvaered)人已经完全占领了瓦里亚(Varia)的表面，所有的工业和军事企业都被迁到了坚固的城堡。虽然空间站三分之二的甲板被大型公司使用，但仍有足够的空间供一个体面的军事联队使用。事实上，坚固的堡垒是周边系统中大多数军事行动的基地。

src: The recreation room of the laboratory has piles of research equipment gathering dust in the corners. There seems to be also poorly refrigerated biological samples that you wouldn't be surprised if they moved. The only recreational things you can find are a chessboard that is missing about a dozen pieces and bottles of ethanol which you probably shouldn't be drinking.
ref: 实验室的娱乐室有成堆的研究设备，角落里积满了灰尘。似乎还有一些冷藏不佳的生物样本，如果它们被转移了，你也不会感到惊讶。你能找到的唯一娱乐物品是一个棋盘，它丢失了大约12个棋子和几瓶乙醇，你可能不应该喝这些东西。

src: Less a bar and more a waiting area, this facility is used for the rare occasions when visitors have reason to come to Tanulwa. Since Tanulwa doesn't allow personal visits to prisoners and all logistics of personnel and goods are handled strictly by the government, there's not much in the way of civilian traffic to and from the planet.
ref: 该设施不是酒吧，而是等候区，用于游客有理由来到塔努尔瓦的罕见场合。由于塔努尔瓦不允许亲自探访囚犯，所有人员和货物的后勤工作都由政府严格处理，因此进出地球的平民交通并不多。

src: Tau Station was constructed with the sole purpose of exploiting the algae produced on Tau Prime. Being a completely oceanic world with a highly corrosive atmosphere, it was deemed more profitable to build an orbiting station, rather than a platform city on the surface. From the station windows you can see heavy algae collectors flying to and from the surface on their endless algae runs.
ref: Tau 空间站的建造唯一目的是利用Tau 主星上产生的藻类。作为一个完全海洋的世界，大气腐蚀性很强，人们认为建造轨道空间站比在表面建造平台城市更有利可图。从空间站的窗户，您可以看到重型藻类收集者沿着无尽的藻类路线往返于地表。

src: Thosson is mostly a normal aquatic world, capitalizing on its abundant supply of water. However, a small Soromid community on this world has taken it upon itself to evolve into water-dwelling creatures through genetic manipulation. So far they haven't had much success, and their position on the planet is rather marginal. By and large, the Soromid believe in space more than in oceans.
ref: Thosson 基本上是一个正常的水生世界，利用其充足的水资源。然而，这个世界上的一个小索洛米德(Soromid)群落已经通过基因操作进化成了水生生物。到目前为止，他们还没有取得太大的成功，他们在地球上的地位相当边缘。总的来说，索洛米德(Soromid)人更相信太空，而不是海洋。

src: People sometimes joke that Soromid will live anywhere, like vermin. This is not true. But a pilot looking at the colony on Thymo might well understand why people say such things. The planet is uninteresting by all means, having little in the way of natural resources and lacking an atmosphere entirely. But the Soromid still live here, mainly because they can. Thymo counts as a civilian world, albeit not a very rich one.
ref: 人们有时开玩笑说，索罗米德会像害虫一样住在任何地方。这不是真的。但是，一个飞行员在观察Thymo上的殖民地时，可能会很好地理解人们为什么会说这样的话。这颗行星无论如何都是无趣的，几乎没有自然资源，完全没有大气层。但索洛米德(Soromid)仍然生活在这里，主要是因为他们可以。Thymo算作一个平民世界，尽管不是一个非常富有的世界。

src: Tummalin is the base of operations of a small mining company. Its primary, Longbow III, is rich in various unusual substances. However, the planet itself is far too unstable to permit a permanent presence, so all mining operations are carried out with mobile harvester ships. It's dangerous work, but as long as there's a market there will always be someone willing to do it.
ref: Tummalin 是一家小型矿业公司的运营基地。它的主星 Longbow III富含各种不寻常的物质。然而，地球本身太不稳定，不允许永久存在，所以所有的采矿作业都是用移动收割机船进行的。这是一项危险的工作，但只要有市场，总会有人愿意做这项工作。

src: Acting as the focal point of the Unicorp corporation, 70% of all company employees are located at Unicorp Orbital. Although the station does not have the full fabrication facilities necessary for producing all the Unicorp products, it has a small workshop mainly focused with collaborating with the research department located at the same station. Once you leave the spaceport you are greeted with the company motto "Quality for All" and a frenzy of employees going to and fro. Quite a lively station.
ref: 作为联合公司(Unicorp)公司的焦点，70%的公司员工位于联合公司(Unicorp) 轨道。尽管该工作站没有生产所有联合公司(Unicorp)产品所需的完整制造设施，但它有一个小型车间，主要专注于与位于同一工作站的研究部门合作。一旦你离开太空港，你就会看到公司的座右铭"人人享有质量"和来来往往的疯狂员工。相当热闹的空间站。

src: This cold, dead, rocky world was named after the man who settled the colony here, an entrepreneur by the name of Shaan Vargo. Vargo was convinced that this planet harboured untold wealth in precious metals and minerals deep underneath its surface. He persisted in his belief right up until his death in the Incident but the miners here never found anything. What they did find was fairly average, which at least sell well enough to keep the colony marginally profitable.
ref: 这颗寒冷死寂的岩石星球以殖民者——企业家沙恩·瓦戈(Shaan Vargo)之名命名。瓦戈坚信该行星地表深处蕴藏着巨量贵金属与矿物资源。直至在大灾变(Incident)中身亡，他仍坚持这一信念，但矿工们始终一无所获。实际开采的矿石品质平庸，所幸销路尚可，勉强维持着殖民地的收支平衡。

src: Yrina is a resource world that's being strip-mined by the Sirii. The climate is harsh and almost all of the planet's surface is frozen, but in some cases that is actually desirable, as substances that would normally be fluid are now solid, and therefore mined more easily. Yrina supplies mostly Aesir, but some of the more exotic elements are exported to other parts of Sirius space, and beyond.
ref: 伊琳娜(Yrina)是天狼星人(Sirii)正进行露天开采的资源星球。这里气候严酷，地表几乎完全冰冻，但这种环境反而有利开采——常态下呈液态的物质在此凝结为固态，更易采掘。该星球主要产出埃希尔矿(Aesir)，部分稀有元素则远销至天狼星(Sirius)星域内外。

src: Most of Zeo's habitation is recently constructed. After the Incident, real estate prices had a major overhaul all across the galaxy and the once neglected backwater world of Zeo quickly became prime land to settle for Imperial citizens. Though the population is still on the low side compared to older civilian worlds, the number of people living here rises by the day.
ref: Zeo的大部分住所都是最近建造的。事件发生后，整个银河系的房地产价格都发生了重大变化，曾经被忽视的泽奥死水世界很快成为帝国公民定居的黄金地段。尽管与老旧的平民世界相比，这里的人口仍然偏低，但居住在这里的人数日益增加。

src: The spaceport facility is part of a larger structure that houses the entirety of this planet's human inhabitants. The complex, more or less, floats on the surface and is tightly sealed against the outside environment. Furthermore, the complex is highly compartmentalized, in case a leak somehow occurs. Some spacers even insist on wearing breathing masks, even in the spaceport bar, just to be on the safe side.
ref: 太空港设施是容纳该星球全部人类居民的庞大建筑群组成部分。这个复合体大致漂浮在星球表面，与外部环境完全隔绝。此外，建筑内部采用高度分隔设计，以防突发泄漏事故。有些太空人甚至坚持在太空港酒吧内也佩戴呼吸面罩，只为万无一失。

src: Ammu is a generally calm planet, once one is accustomed to the constant rumbling of the lava flows. Lava eruptions are often felt in the subterranean spaceport, but the way it doesn't seem to faze the locals reassures you. The lava does have a more positive aspect in attracting industries that need high pressure and temperature to function effectively, but the climate makes Ammu dependent on nearby planets such as Reidd for food supplies.
ref: Ammu 是一个总体上平静的星球，一旦你习惯了不断的熔岩流的隆隆声。在地下太空港经常能感觉到熔岩喷发，但它似乎并没有让当地人感到不安。熔岩确实有一个更积极的方面，可以吸引需要高压和高温才能有效运转的行业，但气候使阿姆依赖于附近的行星，如里德，以获得食物供应。

src: As the habitats of this inhospitable world were being built little thought was given to less essential amenities. This bar was added by grafting it onto the side of the spaceport. Anywhere else in the galaxy being an afterthought would likely have resulted in a rather cramped, run-down bar but here in Soromid space it has given it a more organic feel, so much so that it almost feels like it is growing.
ref: 当这个荒凉世界的栖息地正在建造时，很少有人考虑到不那么必要的便利设施。这根棒子是通过将它嫁接到航天港的一侧而增加的。银河系其他任何地方都是事后才想到的，很可能会导致一个相当狭窄、破旧的酒吧，但在索洛米德(Soromid)空间，它给了它一种更有机的感觉，以至于它几乎感觉到它在成长。

src:
Cetrat is an aquatic planet known for its medical algae. No one has been able to reproduce it exactly as it is in the wild, but with the abundance of it throughout the planet's massive oceans, there has been little effort in that field.
Cetrat was colonized by the eighth colony ship launched during the First Growth, Brooklyn.
ref:
Cetrat 是一颗水生行星，以其药用藻类而闻名。没有人能够将它完全复制成野外的样子，但由于地球上广阔的海洋中存在丰富的这种物质，因此在这一领域几乎没有做出任何努力。
它被Brooklyn第一增长期间发射的第八艘殖民船殖民。

src:
Gilligan's Light was one of the first systems to ever be chosen for a colonization project. Dawn was the first world on which humans set foot in this sector of space, despite the fact that the colony ship sent here, Mythril, was only the fifth to be launched. Nevertheless, Dawn proved to be one of the most fertile expeditions in the First Growth and its development outstripped that of most other worlds.
With the advent of hyperspace travel, Dawn found itself the local capital of the Frontier worlds and so is graced by the Frontier Council hanging overhead. This status is strictly symbolic, but it explains why the FLF have chosen to rally around Gilligan's Light.
ref:
Gilligan's Light是最早被选为殖民计划的星系之一。Dawn是人类在这个星区踏足的第一个世界，尽管被派往此处的殖民飞船Mythril只是第五艘发射的飞船。然而，Dawn被证明是'第一波扩张'中最成功的殖民行动之一，其发展速度超越了大多数其他世界。
随着超空间旅行的出现，Dawn成为了边疆世界的区域首府，因此享有Frontier Council在轨道上运行的殊荣。这一地位虽然纯粹是象征性的，但这解释了为何FLF选择以Gilligan's Light作为集结地。

src: Dowue is a planet known for the infamous "Dowue Syndrome", a condition where patients will temporarily come down with hysteria due to prolonged exposure to certain visual wavelengths. This was at first attributed to a contaminated shipment of food, but later it was found that the sun in the Apez system emitted abnormal wavelengths whose effects were multiplied by particulate in Dowue's atmosphere. Shortly thereafter, it became mandatory for all personnel to wear special goggles designed to filter out the harmful light.
ref: Dowue 是一个以臭名昭著的"Dowue综合征"而闻名的星球，这种情况下，患者会因为长时间暴露在特定的视觉波长下而暂时患上歇斯底里。起初，这被归因于一批受污染的食物，但后来发现，APEZ系统中的太阳发出了反常的波长，其影响被多维大气中的颗粒物放大。此后不久，所有工作人员都必须佩戴专门为过滤有害光线而设计的护目镜。

src:
This is Dvaered High Command, the true seat of power over all Dvaered space, and where the Generals come together and decide on a course of action for the Dvaered military forces.
Understandably, Dvaered High Command is a military stronghold, one of the most heavily guarded places in the galaxy. One needs a certain number of Dvaered commendations to be even allowed to set foot on the station.
ref: 此处即是戴瓦德(Dvaered)最高指挥部——整个戴瓦德(Dvaered)疆域的实际权力中枢，将军们在此聚首并制定军事行动方针。作为军事要塞，戴瓦德(Dvaered)最高指挥部堪称银河系防卫最森严的据点之一，唯有获得足够数量的戴瓦德(Dvaered)表彰方被允许登陆空间站。

src: With over 80% of its surface covered in water, Eenerim teeters on the brink of classes M and O. The population here is spread out over many small or medium sized islands scattered evenly across the globe. The Sirius government has divided up the land between the three echelons, with each island predominantly inhabited by either Shaira, Fyrra, or Serra.
ref: Eenerim80%以上的表面被水覆盖，摇摇欲坠地处于M级和O级的边缘。这里的人口分布在许多中小型岛屿上，均匀分布在全球各地。天狼星政府将这片土地分成三个梯队，每个岛上主要居住着Shaira、Fyrra或Serra。

src:
The seat of the infamously rancorous Procyon Enclave of House Za'lek, Excelcior is one of House Za'lek's richest and most productive worlds and is what gives Procyon its outsized influence on much of House Za'lek.
Many scientific organizations and universities operate out of this planet and its Earth-like environment. Helped along by Za'lek terraforming, Excelcior is also a popular planet for retirees and vacationers.
ref: 作为扎列克(Za'lek)家族臭名昭著的恶毒分支——南河三飞地的驻地，埃克塞尔西奥是扎列克(Za'lek)家族最富饶多产的世界之一，正是它赋予了南河三对扎列克(Za'lek)家族大部分事务的超常影响力。众多科研机构和大学依托这个类地行星的环境开展活动。在扎列克(Za'lek)家族的地形改造助力下，埃克塞尔西奥也成为了退休人士和度假者的热门星球。

src: The Raelid bar fits the Dvaered stereotype well. It's one of the more prominent areas as soon as you exit the docking area, and, as many Dvaered bars seem to be, it's much larger than it functionally needs to be. Far from the spotless bars of Polaris Prime, it's encrusted with dirt and you can sense the presence of other patrons by their smell alone. Truly, a Dvaered bar.
ref: Raelid 酒吧完美契合戴瓦德(Dvaered)的刻板印象。当你走出对接区时，这是最显眼的区域之一，而且就像许多戴瓦德(Dvaered)酒吧那样，它的实用面积远超实际需求。与北极星首府一尘不染的酒吧不同，这里积满污垢，仅凭气味就能感知其他顾客的存在。这才是真正的戴瓦德(Dvaered)酒吧。

src:
Gorgate is a loyal Sirian world. The local story goes that Sirichana once set foot on its surface personally, when the colony was only just established, and showed the colonists the light. This is said to have happened over a hundred cycles ago, however, and records of the colony's early days are scarce and unreliable at best. Still, the locals believe the story without question.
Although battered by plasma storms, the strong ionosphere of the planet keeps the local population safe.
ref:
Gorgate 是一个忠诚的天狼星世界。当地的传说是，当殖民地刚刚建立时，西里查纳(Sirichana)曾亲自踏上它的表面，并向殖民者展示了光明。然而，据说这发生在一百多个周期之前，关于殖民地早期的记录很少，充其量也是不可靠的。尽管如此，当地人还是毫无疑问地相信了这个故事。
尽管遭受了等离子体风暴的打击，但地球上强大的电离层保证了当地居民的安全。

src: Greis has a tradition, and that tradition is that whichever Warlord controls the planet renames it after himself. This often causes confusion among spacers everywhere, who will refer to the world by names that have been rendered obsolete. The current warlord is a man named Harmstadt Greis. His rule isn't particularly benevolent, but he at least doesn't seem worse than most Dvaered Warlords.
ref: Greis 有个传统:控制该星球的军阀都会将其更名为自己的名字。这常给各地太空者造成混乱，他们仍用已过时的名称指代这个世界。现任军阀名为哈姆施塔特·格赖斯。他的统治不算仁政，但至少不比多数戴瓦德(Dvaered)军阀更恶劣。

src: Heii is the rather unattractive moon of Juran. Juran itself is a natural M-class, so first time visitors often wonder why the Soromid chose to settle here and not down below. The reason is actually quite interesting. Juran is home to many amazing life forms, including large creatures not at all unlike the dinosaurs that once roamed ancient Earth. Settling down on Juran would not only be dangerous, it would also mean a disturbance in the natural ecosystem. Thus, the Soromid chose not to inhabit Juran, but instead tap its natural animal life by selling specimens as exotic pets throughout the galaxy.
ref: Heii是Juran一颗相当不起眼的卫星。Juran本身是天然的M级行星，因此初来乍到的访客常常好奇为何索洛米德(Soromid)选择在此定居而非下方的行星。原因其实相当有趣。Juran孕育着众多奇妙的生命形态，包括与远古地球恐龙极为相似的大型生物。在Juran定居不仅危险，还会扰乱其自然生态系统。因此，索洛米德(Soromid)选择不殖民Juran，而是通过向全银河系出售珍奇宠物标本的方式，开发利用其丰富的动物资源。

src: A high-class, though schizophrenic, looking bar with at seat service by servers wearing some very impressive costumes of every sort under the sun. It appears they compete to create the most impressive look they can with the tables they serve matching the style of their costumes. The results patchwork is rather jarring but novel, to say the least, and with clearly a lot of effort put in to create and maintain every aspect… probably to distract the patrons from the hard labour and life threatening conditions they face working here.
ref: 一个高级的，虽然精神分裂，看起来像是服务员在座位上服务的酒吧，在阳光下穿着各种非常令人印象深刻的服装。他们似乎竞相创造出最令人印象深刻的外观，他们提供的餐桌与他们的服装风格相匹配。结果拼凑起来相当不和谐，但至少可以说是新奇的，而且显然投入了大量的精力来创建和维护每个方面的…可能是为了分散顾客对他们在这里工作所面临的艰苦劳动和危及生命的条件的注意力。

src: Although remodeled recently, the spaceport bar reminisces about the origins and past of the planet. From the early settlers who immigrated and built the first city, to said destruction of first city in a major earthquake, and the establishment of Ianella IV as an agricultural low population density world. Local trinkets, baubles, and traditional farming utensils litter the walls, giving it a rustic and homely look.
ref: 尽管最近经过翻新，这座太空港酒吧仍处处诉说着星球的过往历史。从移民至此建立第一座城市的早期开拓者，到这座城市在大地震中毁于一旦，再到Ianella IV最终成为一个人口稀少的农业世界。当地的小饰品、手工艺品和传统农具点缀着墙面，营造出质朴温馨的氛围。

src: Jaan has a big spaceport, and to facilitate the many pilots and crews that pass through it has multiple spaceport bars. Each spaceport bar is exactly the same as all the others, though. Not even the people who frequently visit Jaan can tell them apart. This regularly causes problems for unsuspecting people who promised to meet at the spaceport bar.
ref: Jaan有一个很大的太空港，为了方便许多飞行员和机组人员通过它，有多个太空港酒吧。然而，每个太空港酒吧和所有其他酒吧完全一样。即使是经常光顾Jaan的人也分不清它们。这经常会给那些承诺在太空港酒吧见面的毫无戒心的人带来麻烦。

src: Though Maatsu's surface was never truly tamed, there is a fairly substantial population here. The larger population centres are kept climate neutral by localized weather control systems, while some of the more remote regions are left to the elements. This has made Maatsu a bit of an attraction to adventurous types who like to go out into the wild.
ref: 尽管Maatsu 的表面从未真正被驯服，但这里有相当多的人口。较大的人口中心通过本地化的天气控制系统保持气候中立，而一些较偏远的地区则留给自然要素。这让马松对喜欢冒险的人有了一点吸引力，他们喜欢走进野外。

src: Just like the atmosphere throughout the planet, the spaceport bar is a very glum place. The installations look improvised, but the layers of dust indicate that man cycles have passed without any serious reforms. Many vagabonds spend their time here trying to find a ship to get them out of the dump. Not the best place to spend your time.
ref: 就像整个星球的大气层一样，太空港酒吧是一个非常阴暗的地方。这些设施看起来是即兴的，但层层尘土表明，人类周期已经过去，没有进行任何认真的改革。许多流浪汉在这里度过他们的时间，试图找到一艘船把他们从垃圾堆里救出来。不是消磨时间的最好地方。

src: Majesteka Prime is a tough planet battled by constant storms that can cover an entire hemisphere at a time. Living requires constant battling the elements, which is why the Dvaered designed it as a military training complex. Many rookies spend cycles here where they are hardened by the constant fight against the elements. Those that survive often go on to lead successful military careers in space. Other than the abnormally tempestuous climate, there is not much interesting to the planet.
ref: Majesteka 主星 是一颗环境严酷的行星，不断有风暴肆虐，一次风暴就能覆盖整个半球。在这里生存需要与自然元素持续抗争，因此戴瓦德(Dvaered)将其设计为一处军事训练基地。许多新兵会在这里度过数个周期，通过不断与自然抗争来磨砺意志。幸存者往往能在太空军事生涯中取得成就。除了异常狂暴的气候，这颗行星并无其他特别之处。

src: Manis is a cool world, though it still counts as earthlike. Unlike many other class M planets in the galaxy, no terraforming was ever performed here, so the world has almost the same ecosystem it did when it was first settled during the Second Growth. Many people are attracted to this "authentic" feel of the planet, which accounts for a significant portion of its popularity.
ref: Manis是一个很酷的世界，尽管它仍然被算作是地球。与银河系中的许多其他M类行星不同，这里从未进行过地形形成，所以这个世界拥有几乎与它在第二次生长期间第一次定居时相同的生态系统。许多人被这种"真实"的地球感觉所吸引，这在其受欢迎程度中占了很大一部分。

src: Marius Enclave used to be a customs station of the old Empire, checking traffic bound for Sol and the core Imperial systems. Now, in the post-Incident era, the station had been first repurposed to handle those fleeing from the irradiated worlds and to serve as a first line of defence from anything that can come out of the Sol Nebula. But since it is perpetually under-staffed and under-equipped, Marius Enclave is barely capable of maintaining its own presence in Raelid, let alone protect or manage anything else.
ref: Marius 飞地曾经是旧帝国的一个海关站，检查前往索尔和核心帝国系统的交通。现在，在事件发生后的时代，空间站第一次被重新利用，是为了处理那些逃离受辐射世界的人，并作为抵御任何可能来自索尔星云的东西的第一道防线。但由于一直人手不足和装备不足，Marius 飞地几乎没有能力维持自己在拉利德的存在，更不用说保护或管理其他任何事情了。

src: Although consisting mainly of a shipbuilding factory, Nexus Shipyards HQ also sports an extravagant tower where the executives and marketing work, directly accessible from the spaceport. The lobby is impressive, with marble floors and columns, it is hard to believe that this is a station with such waste of space. There is also a large waiting area and what seems to be some complementary tea for people visiting, and it seems like many people decide to come directly to the Nexus Shipyards HQ to make their ship purchases.
ref: 虽然纳克西斯(Nexus)造船厂总部主要由一家造船厂组成，但它也有一座豪华的塔楼，高管和营销人员在那里工作，从航天港直接可以到达。大堂令人印象深刻，大理石地板和柱子，很难相信这是一个空间如此浪费的空间站。还有一个很大的等候区，似乎是为来访的人准备了一些补充茶，似乎很多人决定直接来纳克西斯(Nexus)造船厂总部买船。

src: Although not a large installation by any measure, Niflheim Enclave is the main commercial station in the southwestern quadrant of Empire space. Though it doesn't see as much traffic as the more centrally located trade hubs, it provides a good opportunity for traders between the Empire, the Za'lek and the Society to meet and greet. Of course, the Imperial Navy also uses this station as a base of operations.
ref: 尽管规模不大，Niflheim 飞地却是帝国星域西南象限主要的商业空间站。虽然其交通流量不如中心地带的贸易枢纽，但为帝国、扎列克(Za'lek)和协会的商人提供了理想的交易场所。当然，帝国海军也将其作为作战基地使用。

src: Nocalin is a fairly good world for human habitation, especially if the humans in question are Soromid. The surface is stable and the native atmosphere is nitrox. Gravitational and orbital statistics are not too far from Earth Standard. There is only one problem: Nocalin is completely and utterly dry. Nothing can grow on this world without importing an ocean's worth of water, which is too costly an operation by any standard. As a result, Nocalin relies entirely on food imports.
ref: Nocalin 是一个相当适合人类居住的世界，特别是如果有问题的人类是索洛米德(Soromid)人的话。表面是稳定的，自然大气是氮氧化物。引力和轨道统计数据与地球标准相差不太远。只有一个问题:诺卡林是完全和完全干燥的。在这个世界上，如果不进口相当于海洋价值的水，就不可能有任何东西生长，而以任何标准衡量，进口水的成本都太高了。因此，诺卡林完全依赖食品进口。

src: First time visitors are always taken aback when they enter this spaceport bar. The centre of the room is occupied by a real, actual Mass Driver cannon, and it's pointing straight at the door. Local rumour has it that the cannon is loaded and powered at all times, and that the bar's proprietor uses it to discourage people from misbehaving in his bar.
ref: 第一次来的游客进入这个太空港酒吧时总是会大吃一惊。房间的中心被一门真正的质量驱动器大炮占据，它直接指向门。当地有传言称，这门大炮随时都装有弹药和动力，酒吧老板用它来阻止人们在他的酒吧里行为不端。

src: The first thing anyone notices when they step into the bar is the ceiling, which is a holographic display of the galaxy, centred around Anarbalis. Though an impressive display as well as a marvel of technology, the bar's proprietor apparently doesn't realize that many of his customers spend all day looking at the stars, and therefore have little desire to look at them when onworld.
ref: 当人们走进酒吧时，首先注意到的就是天花板，这是银河系的全息显示，以阿纳巴利斯为中心。尽管酒吧的展示令人印象深刻，技术也令人惊叹，但酒吧老板显然没有意识到他的许多顾客整天都在看星星，因此在世界上时几乎不想看它们。

src: Some planets just don't have the capacity to feed their own populations, despite advanced crop-growing techniques. Reidd is not one of those planets. In fact, Reidd's orbit and axial inclination make it such a good farming world that it can supply many worlds in nearby systems. The local government acknowledges this, and has dedicated 97% of Reidd's land surface to agricultural operations.
ref: 尽管采用了先进的作物种植技术，但有些星球根本没有能力养活自己的人口。Reidd 不是那些行星中的一员。事实上，Reidd 的轨道和轴向倾斜使它成为一个非常好的农业星球，可以供应附近系统中的许多星球。当地政府承认这一点，并将Reidd 97%的土地用于农业生产。

src: On the edge of the Delta Pavonis system, unnoticed by all but a few, orbits the tiny world of Seanich. Though technically a registered Imperial colony, this backwater planet does not receive the attention that should come with its status. The population is decidedly upset about this, to the point that the local administration has stopped paying taxes to the central Imperial government in protest. The Imperial government hasn't noticed.
ref: 在 Delta Pavonis星系的边缘，围绕着小行星Seanich运行，只有少数人没有注意到这一点。尽管从技术上讲，这颗死水星球是登记在册的帝国殖民地，但它并没有受到应有的关注。民众对此非常不满，以至于当地政府已经停止向中央帝国政府缴税以示抗议。帝国政府没有注意到这一点。

src: Skater was never of much interest to visitors, but it can be a surprisingly good place to live. If you're a Soromid. The spaceport bar acts as a sort of low-profile tourist centre, providing visitors with information about the colony and its environment. The local authorities hope to attract more people to the planet in order to grow the local economy.
ref: Skater 从来没有引起游客的兴趣，但它可以是一个出人意料的好地方居住。如果你是索洛米德(Soromid)家的。太空港酒吧充当了一种低调的旅游中心，为游客提供关于殖民地及其环境的信息。地方当局希望吸引更多的人来到这个星球，以发展当地经济。

src: Tankard Cloister is a Sirius economical space facility. It processes a large portion of all trade transactions made within An'ku, and also serves as a terminal for the materials produced by Sroolu. There is also a small security detail stationed here, but this is merely for the purpose of customs, not so much the repulsion of hostile elements.
ref: Tankard Cloister是天狼星经济型太空设施。它处理An ' ku内所有贸易交易的大部分，也是Sroolu生产材料的终端。这里还驻扎着一个小规模的保安人员，但这只是为了海关的目的，而不是为了排斥敌对分子。

src: Tesla Station is the centre of operations for the Xeric experimental weapons testing site. Many high energy physics researchers flock over for the easier chances of funding, and more importantly, the ability to perform high energy physics experiments with little or no ethics committee oversight. The result is that the base feels no real different from any large Za'lek research centre or university.
ref: Tesla 站是Xeric实验武器测试场的运营中心。许多高能物理研究人员蜂拥而至，是为了更容易获得资金，更重要的是，为了能够在很少或根本没有道德委员会监督的情况下进行高能物理实验。结果是，该基地感觉与任何大型扎列克(Za'lek)研究中心或大学没有真正的不同。

src: Thar is a simple mining world owned by the Dvaered. It has a very variable atmosphere that can rapidly alternate from several kilometres wide to barely existent. The pressure changes are harmful to most lifeforms, making it an almost completely sterile planet. With the advent of terraforming techniques it was finally made habitable for humans so they could exploit some of its many resources.
ref: Thar是戴瓦德(Dvaered)人拥有的一个简单的采矿世界。它的大气层非常多变，可以从几公里宽迅速变化到几乎不存在。压力的变化对大多数生命形式都是有害的，使它成为一个几乎完全无菌的星球。随着地球化技术的出现，它终于适合人类居住，这样他们就可以利用它的许多资源。

src: It's a nickname, of course. How could it not be? Trouble is, nobody remembers where the name came from, and, bizarrely, there are no records of the station's original name. It's quite a famous story, both within Hekaras and elsewhere. Meanwhile, all involved simply call it Three and a Half Kings. It seems to work for them. Despite the curious name, Three and a Half Kings is a fairly unremarkable station, offering its services to ships that pass by.
ref: 当然，这是一个昵称。怎么可能不是呢？问题是，没有人记得这个名字是从哪里来的，奇怪的是，没有关于这个空间站原始名称的记录。无论是在Hekaras 还是在其他地方，这都是一个相当著名的故事。与此同时，所有参与其中的人都简单地称它为三个半国王。这似乎对他们很管用。尽管名字很奇怪，但三个半国王号是一个相当不起眼的空间站，为过往的船只提供服务。

src: The bar has a window that looks out over the main docks for the harvester ships that the miners use to collect resources from the planet below. The ships are ugly and battered, but they are always kept in prime working condition. A malfunction on the surface of Longbow III can quickly lead to the deaths of all crew.
ref: 酒吧有一扇窗户，可以俯瞰主要码头，观看矿工用来从下面的星球收集资源的采矿船。这些船很难看，破旧不堪，但它们总是保持在最佳工作状态。长弓三号表面的一次故障很快就会导致所有机组人员死亡。

src: This is a bar. It has to be, because you usually don't have to pay for muddy rainwater. It doesn't seem this place is frequented by its patrons for the purpose of entertainment, because there are no recreational facilities, not even a jukebox. The few appointments are welded to the floor, and everything else is either made out of steel or has steel bars covering it. Clearly, this is a place where fists meet faces. Maybe you shouldn't stay here too long…
ref: 这是一家酒吧。这是必须的，因为你通常不必为浑浊的雨水买单。似乎这个地方的顾客并不是为了娱乐而经常光顾的，因为这里没有娱乐设施，甚至连点唱机都没有。为数不多的几个约会都是焊接在地板上的，其他所有东西要么是钢做的，要么是有钢筋覆盖的。显然，这是一个拳头相遇的地方。也许你不应该在这里呆太久，…

src: Miner bars are miner bars the galaxy over, but Sirian miner bars distinguish themselves by incorporating the typical Sirian spirituality into the down-to-earth-and-lower nature of a mining colony. Miners frequently come above ground to perform their religious ceremonies, and so are less prone to the stress and mental trauma that a prolonged stay in a mine can cause.
ref: 矿工酒吧是银河系的矿工酒吧，但天狼星矿工酒吧通过将典型的天狼星精神融入到采矿殖民地的脚踏实地和低级自然中而脱颖而出。矿工们经常来到地面上举行宗教仪式，因此不太容易受到长期呆在矿井中可能造成的压力和精神创伤的影响。

src: Frozen worlds are usually not colonized unless there is good reason. Vilati Vilata is no exception. The world offers a wealth of valuable natural resources, as well as expansive subglacial cavern systems that lend themselves quite well to human habitation. The Dvaered based, what would become, one of their most successful industrial franchises on this planet, so although nobody likes living here, the place is home to a sizeable number of workers.
ref: 冰冻星球通常不会被殖民——除非有充分理由。维拉提·维拉塔(Vilati Vilata)正是如此。这个世界不仅蕴藏大量珍贵自然资源，其广阔的冰下洞穴系统也极适合人类居住。戴瓦德(Dvaered)在此建立了他们最成功的工业特许经营体系之一，因此尽管无人喜欢在此生活，这里仍聚居着数量可观的工人群体。

src: A small, poor colony on the edge of Sirius inhabited space, Wagenni is one of those places that are doomed to forever dangle at the bottom rung of interstellar society. The locals lead a rough, underpaid existence, the kind that sparked the Dvaered Revolts elsewhere in the galaxy. Yet, there is no sign of discontent here. The Sirii have accepted their fate and take strength from their faith.
ref: 瓦根尼(Wagenni)是位于天狼星(Sirius)殖民星域边缘的一个贫穷小殖民地，注定永远徘徊在星际社会的底层。当地居民过着艰苦而贫瘠的生活——这种境遇曾在银河系其他地区引发戴瓦德(Dvaered)起义。但这里却不见任何不满迹象，天狼星人(Sirii)坦然接受命运，并从信仰中汲取力量。

src: In the days of the Old Empire, Waterhole was the farthest outpost of the Empire. To the Imperials, it was the last outpost of civilization, the last bastion of safety before venturing out into the systems beyond. It is because of this that Waterhole, the system and the planet, derive their names. Now, centuries later, Waterhole remains at the border of Empire space. Although it is no longer the border of civilized society, with the establishment of House Za'lek and House Goddard, it is still the last stop for traders venturing out of Imperial space, and the first of those coming in.
ref:
在古帝国时期，水坑(Waterhole)曾是帝国最偏远的哨站。对帝国子民而言，它既是文明的最后前哨，也是前往域外星系前的最后安全堡垒——整个星系与行星因此得名。
数世纪后的今天，水坑仍位于帝国疆域边境。尽管随着扎列克(Za'lek)家族与戈达德(Goddard)家族的建立，这里已非文明社会的边界，
却依然是商队驶离帝国疆域前的最后一站，也是外来者进入帝国的首站。

src: Zuner's surface has been dedicated almost entirely to crop growing. While there are some urban centres scattered around the world, their population is low compared to the residential megaplexes of more densely populated worlds. Though the community is, to a large extent, agricultural, the inhabitants are in no way out of touch with the rest of the galaxy and are, in fact, quite wealthy, due to how lucrative Zuner's choice of food production is.
ref: Zuner 的地表几乎全部用于农作物种植。虽然世界各地有一些城市中心，但与人口更稠密的世界的大型住宅区相比，这些城市的人口很少。尽管这个社区在很大程度上是农业社区，但由于祖纳选择的食物生产是多么有利可图，居民们并没有以任何方式与银河系的其他地方脱离，事实上，他们相当富有。

src: Named after the Egyptian god of death, Anubis was established as a mining base by a mining faction even before the Faction Wars. The abundance of radioactive and heavy elements made the planet a good location to produce weapons, a lucrative business given its relative proximity to Sol. During the Faction Wars, Anubis was annexed by the Empire but the local population subsequently joined the protest movement that eventually led to the establishment of House Dvaered. Today, the Dvaered use Anubis to produce ammunition and light combat ships which are shipped back to the Dvaered territories.
ref: Anubis 以埃及死神的名字命名，甚至在派系战争之前就被一个矿业派别建立为采矿基地。丰富的放射性和重元素使这个星球成为生产武器的好地方，考虑到它离索尔相对较近，这是一个有利可图的行业。在派系战争期间，阿努比斯被帝国吞并，但当地民众随后加入了抗议运动，最终导致了戴瓦德(Dvaered)家族的建立。今天，戴瓦德(Dvaered)人使用Anubis 生产弹药和轻型战舰，然后运回戴瓦德(Dvaered)领土。

src: Arashu is a peculiar planet, it is both oceanic and highly volcanic. The planet's oceanic crust is prone to earthquakes, this causes tidal waves to wash over the few areas of dry land. A Sirian corporation has invested in harnessing the energies released by this process, turning the planet into a profitable weapons production plant. All manufacturing happens on floating platforms so the workers and equipment are safe from the constant seismic activity.
ref: Arashu是一颗奇特的行星，它既是海洋性的，又是高度火山性的。地球的海洋地壳容易发生地震，这导致潮汐波冲刷着陆地上的少数几个区域。一家天狼星公司投资利用这一过程释放的能量，将地球变成一个有利可图的武器生产工厂。所有的生产都在浮动平台上进行，因此工人和装备都不会受到持续的地震活动的影响。

src: The spaceport bar is arranged around a central area that serves as a showcase for the single largest uncut gem ever found under the sands of Berkhere. It is a reminder to both visitors and the local populace that Berkhere is still wealthy. So long as the gem on display doesn't have to be sold, the reasoning goes, Berkhere's future isn't in peril. Needless to say, the gem is heavily protected by security systems.
ref: 太空港酒吧围绕着一个中心区域，作为伯克希尔沙子下迄今发现的最大的未切割宝石的展示窗口。这对游客和当地民众都是一个提醒，伯克希尔仍然很富有。理由是，只要展出的宝石不必出售，伯克希尔的未来就不会岌岌可危。不用说，宝石受到安全系统的严密保护。

src: Given the relative stability of this world the bar looks rather more Empire standard-issue than on many Soromid worlds. There are tables, chairs, dispensers, a barman and, most importantly, drinks. These there are in profusion, though, this being a smaller world, not in any great variety. If you ask for a cocktail though, you'll likely be directed to one of the local sulphurous hot-water geysers.
ref: 考虑到这个世界的相对稳定性，酒吧看起来更像是帝国的标准问题，而不是在许多索洛米德(Soromid)世界上。有桌子，椅子，自动售货机，酒吧招待，最重要的是，饮料。不过，这是一个更小的世界，没有什么大的变化。如果你要一杯鸡尾酒，你可能会被引导到当地的一个含硫热水喷泉。

src: Fishing is the name of the game on Crylo and the spaceport bar is nothing if not in character. Almost everything in here is fish-themed, including the bar, which has been made out of the spine of some gargantuan aquatic creature. Some of the more experimental drinks might also be better avoided unless you like your ingredients very fresh indeed.
ref: 钓鱼是Crylo上的游戏名称，如果不是角色，太空港酒吧就什么都不是。这里几乎所有的东西都是以鱼为主题的，包括酒吧，它是用某种巨大的水生动物的脊椎制成的。一些更具实验性的饮料可能也会更好地避免，除非你真的喜欢你的配料非常新鲜。

src: The bar is located under sea level with view the abyssal depths of the sea. From the windows you can see lots of small dust-like animals and plants floating around. If you get very lucky, you can get to see a large jelly whale passing by. They have been known to try to engulf and devour the bar leading to quite a impressive, yet harmless, spectacle. Most of the drinks are local, with premium jellywhale extracts-based beverages.
ref: 酒吧位于海平面以下，可以看到大海的深渊。从窗户上你可以看到许多像尘埃一样的小动物和植物漂浮在周围。如果你非常幸运，你可以看到一头巨大的水母鲸从你身边经过。众所周知，它们试图吞噬酒吧，导致相当令人印象深刻，但无害的奇观。大多数饮料都是本地的，含有优质的水母鲸萃取物饮料。

src: Europea is almost completely covered in water, which was considered undesirable in the early days of the Second Growth. However, it was soon discovered that Europea's biosphere contained many organisms that were useful in the production of high-grade medicine and an exception was made. This means that Europea is one of the earliest O-class planets that were ever colonised. Today the world still thrives on its medical exports, though advances in pharmaceutical technology since the days of the Second Growth have rendered a considerable portion of it obsolete.
ref: 欧洲几乎完全被水覆盖，这在第二次增长的早期被认为是不可取的。然而，人们很快发现，欧洲的生物圈中含有许多对生产高级药物有用的生物，因此破例了。这意味着欧洲是最早被殖民的O级行星之一。今天，世界仍然依靠其医疗出口蓬勃发展，尽管自第二次增长以来，制药技术的进步已经使其中相当一部分已经过时。

src: Ferrungir is a fairly low-profile industrial world. Raw materials are being mined here and then either shipped offworld immediately or processed into low-level components before heading the same way. There is not much else of value on this planet. The people who live here tend to be Shaira echelon who haven't been able to find a job anywhere else.
ref: Ferrungir 是一个相当低调的工业世界。原材料是在这里开采的，然后要么立即运往国外，要么加工成低级别的部件，然后再运往同样的方向。在这个星球上没有太多其他的价值。住在这里的人往往是Shaira echelon，他们在其他地方找不到工作。

src: Fuzka is a fairly typical Imperial civilian world. It has a good atmosphere, stable tectonics and a large population. The world grows most of its own food but still needs imports to make ends meet. The local population is as well off as can be expected from a middle-class Imperial colony. Otherwise, there is little to note about Fuzka.
ref: Fuzka 是一个相当典型的帝国平民世界。这里大气层好，构造稳定，人口众多。世界上大部分粮食都是自己种植的，但仍需要进口来维持收支平衡。当地居民的富裕程度与中产阶级帝国殖民地的预期不相上下。否则，关于富兹卡就没有什么值得注意的了。

src:
All of the Empire's military cadets end up having a mandatory stay at Gamma Enclave. Although not luxurious by any standard, it is well organized and designed for dealing with large numbers of personnel. The station is well equipped for organizing in-system exercises with in-depth visualizations of everything that is happening locally.
Although the space docks are not large enough to allow for ship construction, the station is also well suited for making adjustments and repairs on even the largest of Empire vessels.
ref:
帝国所有的军校学员最终都必须住在Gamma 飞地。虽然以任何标准来看都不算豪华，但它的组织和设计都很好，可以处理大量的人员。空间站装备精良，可以组织系统内演习，对当地正在发生的一切进行深入的可视化。
尽管太空码头不够大，不足以建造船只，但空间站也非常适合对最大的帝国飞船进行调整和维修。

src:
Gerhart Central was built by the Za'lek Central Council in response to the Empire building Outbound Enclave. The Za'lek felt miffed that the Empire would step in on what they saw as their space and, instead of meekly backing down or risking military conflict, merely built a larger and better-equipped station.
The fact that it would also be an ideal location for defending the Za'lek from Imperial treachery, or for launching an attack into the Empire itself, is an open secret.
ref:
扎列克(Za'lek)中央理事会建造格哈特中央站（Gerhart Central），以此回应帝国建立边疆飞地的举动。对于帝国介入他们视为己方星域的行为，扎列克(Za'lek)虽感恼怒，却既未示弱撤退，也未冒险引发军事冲突，而是建造了规模更大、装备更精良的空间站。
这个设施既是防御帝国背刺的理想据点，也可作为向帝国本土发动攻击的跳板——这一事实早已是公开的秘密。

src: Although the bar is in the Imperial part of the station, it has been reformed from the inside out and rebranded as the Hubfar Beer Garden. There is always an assortment of merry soldiers munching down on all sorts of hearty foods with beer constantly flowing. Not a bad place if you are into that sort of stuff.
ref: 虽然这家酒吧位于空间站的帝国区，但它已从内到外完成改造，并更名为Hubfar啤酒花园。这里总能看到兴高采烈的士兵们大快朵颐各种丰盛食物，啤酒更是源源不断。如果你喜欢这种氛围，这里倒是个不错的选择。

src: The sprawling structure of what seems to have been once a colossal hypergate, but lies in complete ruins. Most of the structure is unrecognizable with deep scars and burns, however, there is a small area that seems to have been slightly refurbished and you can dock your ship. Surprisingly enough, some basic electronics are working, although it seems like no part is from the original structure, and some makeshift atmosphere generator allows moving around without a HEV suit. Not the greatest place to land, but at least you can siphon fuel to refuel your ship.
ref: 这个庞大的结构似乎曾经是一个巨大的超级门，但现在已经完全变成了废墟。大部分结构都面目全非，有深深的伤疤和烧伤，然而，有一小块区域似乎经过了轻微翻新，您可以停靠您的船。令人惊讶的是，一些基本的电子设备正在工作，尽管似乎没有任何部分来自原始结构，而且一些临时大气发生器可以在不穿混合动力汽车防护服的情况下四处移动。这不是最适合着陆的地方，但至少你可以吸走燃料为你的船加油。

src: This is just mostly an ordinary bar that occasionally streams public trials on holovid. The security is a bit tighter than most places, but it is rather subtle. Most of the clientele are people coming to the trials as the judges and lawyers all have their own private offices aboard the station, and do not come here often.
ref: 这基本上只是个普通酒吧，偶尔会通过全息影像直播公开审判。安保措施虽比多数场所稍显严格，但布置得颇为隐蔽。大多数顾客都是参与审判的相关人士——由于法官和律师在空间站上都拥有私人办公室，他们并不常光顾此处。

src: This Class-O planet is another purely residential planet in Za'lek space, with a rather large population and several university campuses. The standard of living is rather high, and life expectancy is long, making it a popular place to live out a retirement. Other than that, there isn't much to recommend it to adventurers. Which is just how many of the inhabitants like it.
ref: 这颗O级行星是扎列克(Za'lek)星域内的另一颗纯居住星球，人口相当庞大，拥有多所大学校园。这里生活水平较高，居民寿命较长，因此成为退休生活的热门选择。除此之外，对于冒险者而言就没有太多吸引之处了——而这正是多数居民所期望的状态。

src: Laarss is a resource world. Before the inception of House Dvaered, it used to supply the Imperial economy with raw materials at bottom prices. Nowadays, its chief export market is Eist Shipyard, which is in constant need of ship building resources. Though Laarss is largely the same mining colony it was before, working here is considered something of a privilege among Dvaered citizens, considering its location in Dvaer.
ref: Laarss是一颗资源星球。在戴瓦德(Dvaered)家族成立前，这里曾以最低价格向帝国经济供应原材料。如今其主要出口市场是Eist 造船厂,该厂始终需要大量舰船建造资源。尽管拉尔斯本质上仍是过去的采矿殖民地，但鉴于其位于戴瓦德(Dvaered)境内，在此工作被戴瓦德(Dvaered)公民视为某种特权。

src: Though Coriolis was the second colony ship, it arrived at Lapra well after New Dortmund had been colonized due to technical difficulties and unforeseen incidents during the journey. When it finally did establish orbit around Lapra, it found a world so low on potential for life that the trip almost seemed like a lost cause. However, upon touchdown the colonists found that there were many useful minerals hidden below the surface of the planet. The colony on Lapra has survived, first out of sheer necessity and later by virtue of its exports.
ref: 虽然Coriolis是第二艘殖民飞船，但由于航行期间的技术故障和意外事故，它抵达Lapra的时间远在New Dortmund完成殖民之后。当飞船最终进入拉普拉轨道时，殖民者们发现这个星球的生存条件如此恶劣，几乎让这次航行看起来毫无意义。然而在着陆后，他们却在星球地表下发现了大量有用矿物。拉普拉殖民地就这样存活了下来——最初是迫于生存需要，后来则依靠矿产出口维持发展。

src: Given that few ships wish to land on Maanen's Moon, and exacerbated by the fact that even fewer are given clearance, the spaceport bar has few patrons. Most of them are Imperial bureaucrats and military personal who are forced to live here to try to keep control of the population; among the faces here, there is an almost universal look of desperation to leave this planet.
ref: 考虑到很少有船只希望在马嫩的月球上着陆，更糟糕的是，获得许可的船只更少，太空港酒吧几乎没有顾客。他们中的大多数是帝国官僚和军人，他们被迫住在这里，试图控制人口；在这里的面孔中，几乎所有人都有一种绝望的表情，想要离开这个星球。

src: The bar is hidden deep inside the military complex citadel in a futile effort to guard it against the elements. The floor is a constant mess of mud that never quite dries. Due to the abrasiveness of the elements contained in the mud, cleaning robots never really survive long and it has become a custom for newer recruits to be forced to futilely try to mop the floor. The selection of drinks is dominated by a stout brewed locally from algae that thrives in the constant storms. It is extremely sour and leaves a bitter aftertaste, but all the locals seem to be completely used to it.
ref: 酒吧隐藏在军事建筑群堡垒的深处，徒劳地试图保护它免受恶劣天气的影响。地板上总是一团烂泥，从来不会完全干掉。由于泥中所含元素的磨损性，清洁机器人永远不会真正存活很长时间，新入伍的人被迫徒劳地拖地板已经成为一种习惯。饮料的选择主要是当地酿造的烈性啤酒，这种啤酒是从在持续不断的暴风雨中茁壮成长的藻类酿造的。它非常酸，留下了苦涩的回味，但所有当地人似乎都完全习惯了。

src: For many non-Soromid, Neurri's bar is a home away from home. Quite a lot of traders come to this planet, so the spaceport bar always has a high number of "regulars" in it. Not that they really mind being around the Soromid, of course. Fine people, the Soromid. They just start giving you the creeps after a while, know what I mean?
ref: 对于许多非索洛米德(Soromid)人来说，Neurri酒吧是他们的另一个家。有相当多的商人来到这个星球，所以太空港酒吧里总是有大量的"常客"。当然，他们并不是真的介意和索罗米德在一起。很好的人，索洛米德(Soromid)。一段时间后，他们就开始让你毛骨悚然，明白我的意思吗？

src:
New Dortmund was founded by the very first colony ship to leave Earth, Genesis. The planet itself was known only by its systematic designation for a long time, New Dortmund being the name of the settlement. However, since the settlement was the only thing the colonists knew for many years, its name became synonymous with the world. The moon Folevo was named after the leader of the Genesis expedition, who sadly perished only a few years after the initial touchdown.
New Dortmund was never very successful in any sense of the term, but it is still pulling its weight in the overall Frontier economy.
ref: New Dortmund是由第一艘离开地球的殖民地飞船--创世纪号建立的。这颗行星本身在很长一段时间里只被系统地命名，新多特蒙德就是这个定居点的名字。然而，由于殖民地是殖民者多年来唯一知道的事情，它的名字成为了世界的代名词。Folevo卫星是以创世纪探险队的领导人的名字命名的，不幸的是，他在首次着陆仅几年后就去世了。New Dortmund在任何意义上都不是非常成功的，但它仍然在整个边境经济中发挥着自己的作用。

src:
The New Space Trade Hub gathers the largest representation of the different organizations of the Space Trade Society. Originally called the Santoros Chapter Station, since the original Space Trade Hub was destroyed in the Incident, it was re-inaugurated as the replacement and renamed the New Space Trade Hub. With the recent expansion, it is now considered the largest free-floating station in the galaxy.
The station is split into 4 different wings housing the assortment of guilds and unions that belong to the Space Trade Society, and even quite a few that do not. The large number of people working at the station, combined with the constant flux of incoming traders and merchants makes it very lively with trade offers being discussed even in the hallways. Security is provided by the mercenary guild Astra Vigilis who make sure that pirates and wanted individuals do not get on station, at least the most obvious ones, anyway.
ref: 新太空贸易枢纽汇聚了太空贸易协会旗下各组织的最大规模代表机构。该站原名为桑托罗斯(Santoros)分会站，在初代贸易枢纽毁于事故后，经重建更名为此。凭借近期扩建，现已成为银河系规模最大的自由漂浮空间站。全站分为四大翼区，容纳了隶属于太空贸易协会的各类行会与工会，甚至包括不少非成员组织。常驻工作人员与往来商旅的持续流动，使得站内各处充满活力，连走廊里都时常进行着交易洽谈。安保工作由佣兵组织「守望者」(Astra Vigilis)负责，他们至少能确保海盗和明显被通缉者无法登站——当然，仅限于那些最显眼的目标。

src: New Xantusia is the main headquarters of the Astra Vigilis mercenary guild, one of the important members of the Space Traders Society. Being quite small in size, there is only a single city sprawling nearly a third of the planet's frozen surface. The guild motto "No Escape from the Pull of the Stars" is prominent in the large spaceport that accommodates what seems to be many mismatched combat-ready vessels. Directly accessible from the spaceport is the Astra Vigilis guildhall, with the Space Traders Society hall of guilds adjacent to it. Although most of the organizations are present, most of the people coming to the planet are those looking for dealings with Astra Vigilis members.
ref: 新赞图西亚是守望者雇佣军协会的主要总部，该协会是太空商人协会的重要成员之一。由于面积很小，只有一座城市覆盖了地球冰冻表面的近三分之一。公会的座右铭"不能从星星的拉动中逃脱"在这个巨大的太空港里很显眼，那里似乎容纳了许多不匹配的战斗准备舰艇。从太空港可以直接到达守望者市政厅，旁边是太空贸易协会行会大厅。虽然大多数组织都在场，但大多数来到这个星球的人都是那些希望与守望者成员打交道的人。

src: The Nexus bar is split into two areas: one caters the executive class and people looking for more drinks with hefty price tags, while the other is more simple and dedicated to serving the factory workers. The kitchen seems to be the same for both of them, the main thing that changes is the presentation and expenses. Both areas have a good overlook of the ship factory, where you can see the assembly line constantly producing new ships to try to meet the demand. It seems like business is booming for Nexus Shipyards.
ref: 纳克西斯(Nexus)酒吧分为两个区域:一个迎合高管阶层和寻求更多高价饮品的人，另一个更简单，致力于为工厂工人服务。厨房对他们来说似乎都是一样的，主要的变化是展示和费用。这两个地区都可以很好地俯瞰造船厂，在那里你可以看到装配线不断生产新船，试图满足需求。纳克西斯(Nexus)造船厂的业务似乎正在蓬勃发展。

src: Phee is a tad hot, but it's still habitable. The people who live here have to be healthy and robust to stand the environment, and that's the reason why Dvaered High Command likes to conscript new soldiers from this world. But rather than feel dissatisfied about this, the population takes pride in its history of military service. These people are true Dvaered.
ref: Phee 星略显炎热，但仍适宜居住。本地居民必须拥有强健体魄才能适应环境，这也成为戴瓦德(Dvaered)最高指挥部偏好从此星球征召新兵的原因。但居民非但没有对此不满，反而以悠久的服役历史为荣。这些人是真正的戴瓦德(Dvaered)人。

src: Rostra is another enclave core world. The Straight Row is the largest of the enclaves, but also the weakest, with a divided agenda and the burden of dealing with pirates trying to break into Za'lek space. As such, Rostra does not have quite the same amenities as the other enclave cores, and the intellectual elite here live here primarily to avoid the politics in other enclaves and the capital.
ref: Rostra 是另一个飞地核心世界。Straight Row是最大的飞地，但也是最弱的，议程分散，还要应付试图闯入扎列克(Za'lek)星域的海盗。因此，罗斯特拉没有其他飞地核心那样的便利设施，这里的知识精英居住在此主要是为了躲避其他飞地和首都的政治纷争。

src: Simoen is the only habitable planet in the Kraft system, just barely. Crops don't grow well here and life is hardly luxurious, but there are reasons for humans to live here all the same. Like many desert planets, Simoen has a lot of space for solar power, which makes energy prices here very low. This makes the world interesting for all kinds of manufacturing operations.
ref: Simoen 是Kraft 星系中唯一适合人类居住的行星，勉强算是。这里的庄稼长得不好，生活也算不上奢侈，但人类仍然有理由住在这里。像许多沙漠行星一样，西蒙恩有很大的太阳能空间，这使得这里的能源价格非常低。这让世界对所有类型的制造业务都很有趣。

src: Despite being a fairly typical civilian Sirius world where Sirii of all echolons make their home, Sinass stands out for having some of the best civilian academies. It is common for highly educated Sirii to make the choice between a military career and study at the Socrates Academy Monastery, or focus on civilian applications by studying at Sinass. Additionally, Sinass provides most of the supplies needed by Sirius Monastery, ensuring the stability of thy system.
ref: 尽管是一个相当典型的平民天狼星世界，天狼星在所有回声中都有自己的家，但辛纳斯因拥有一些最好的民用学院而脱颖而出。对于受过高等教育的天狼星来说，在军事生涯和在苏格拉底学院修道院学习之间做出选择是很常见的，或者通过在锡纳斯学习专注于民用应用。此外，Sinass提供了天狼星Monastery所需的大部分补给，确保了你系统的稳定。

src: Sinclair was named after one of the more renowned nobles in House Dvaered, Godfried Sinclair. Like all Dvaered nobles he was a Warlord, and his victories in battle as well as the manner in which he won them earned him the respect in his House as well as the rest of the Empire. The planet that came to bear his name was the last of his conquests, and ultimately became his final resting place. The tomb is a popular destination for Dvaered pilgrims.
ref: Sinclair 是以戴瓦德(Dvaered)家族中最著名的贵族之一戈德弗里德·辛克莱的名字命名的。像所有逃亡的贵族一样，他是一个军阀，他在战斗中的胜利以及他赢得这些胜利的方式为他赢得了他的家族和帝国其他地方的尊重。以他的名字命名的星球是他最后的征服之地，最终成为他最后的安息之地。这座陵墓是戴瓦德(Dvaered)朝圣者的热门目的地。

src: From the outside, FLF station Sindbad looks like a piece of junk. This suits the FLF, as their base isn't meant to stand out. The more travellers believe that the station is just another carcass floating in space, the better. On the inside however, Sindbad looks, well, it still looks like a piece of junk. The FLF have limited resources, and the fact that they have a secret, autonomous outpost at all must be considered an achievement. Still, Sindbad is more than a token resistance. The base has all the facilities and defensive capabilities that befit a structure its size, and while stealth remains the FLF's best protection from their Dvaered oppressors, Sindbad can defend itself if need be.
ref: 从外部看，FLF空间站辛巴达就像一堆太空垃圾。这种伪装正合FLF心意，毕竟他们的基地本就不该引人注目。越多的过客认为这不过是又一座漂浮在宇宙中的废弃空壳，就越好。至于内部？辛巴达看起来...好吧，还是一堆破烂。FLF资源有限，能拥有这样一座秘密自主前哨站已然堪称壮举。虽然如此，辛巴达绝非象征性抵抗据点。该基地配备了与其规模相称的全套设施与防御能力，尽管隐蔽性仍是FLF对抗戴瓦德(Dvaered)压迫者的最佳护盾，但必要时辛巴达也能自我防卫。

src: Stutee is a former prison world of the Old Empire. Since it had a breathable atmosphere and little else, it was deemed perfect for dropping off criminals and then forgetting about them. However, as the lower class workers rebelled against the Empire, resulting in the inception of House Dvaered, Stutee came to fall under the jurisdiction of the new Great House. House Dvaered decided to settle Stutee more permanently, bringing the former convicts under their rule and setting them to work. Though Stutee is still of little material value, its location one jump off Dvaer makes up for that.
ref: 斯图蒂(Stutee)是旧帝国的前监狱世界。由于它有可呼吸的空气，几乎没有其他东西，因此它被认为非常适合放下罪犯，然后忘记他们。然而，随着下层阶级工人反抗帝国，导致戴瓦德(Dvaered)家族的成立，斯图蒂开始落入新的大家族的管辖之下。戴瓦德(Dvaered)家族决定更永久地安置斯图蒂，将这些前罪犯置于他们的统治之下并让他们工作。虽然斯图蒂仍然没有什么物质价值，但它的位置离戴瓦德(Dvaered)只有一步之遥，弥补了这一点。

src: The bar is very lively, filled with physics researchers discussing the results of the latest experiments and research directions. From how crowded the bar is, you get the impression that most of the researchers rather converse here than the cramped research rooms. The walls all being whiteboards helps keep the atmosphere tense, more so than than holopanels. There is a prominent sign behind the counter that says "7 periods since the last accident" with a sticky note underneath that says "thanks fred".
ref: 酒吧里非常热闹，挤满了物理研究人员，讨论最新实验的结果和研究方向。从酒吧的拥挤程度来看，你会得到这样的印象:大多数研究人员宁愿在这里交谈，也不愿在狭窄的研究室里交谈。墙壁都是白板，有助于保持气氛紧张，比全板更重要。柜台后面有一个显眼的标志，上面写着"自上次事故以来已度过7个疗程"，下面有一张便利贴，上面写着"谢谢弗雷德"。

src:
The Wringer is actually called Ulysses Outpost, but apart from a few worn, rusted name plates there is nothing that reminds the people onboard of that name. Once an outlying scientific installation of the Old Empire, the facility was abandoned as the funds needed to keep it running dried up under ever increasing budget cuts following the end of the Empire's golden age.
Since then, the station has been claimed by petty criminals and loners, people who are persona non grata in whatever region they come from, but are unwilling or unable to turn pirate. Needless to say, the Wringer is not the most pleasant of places, and few come here by choice. Even the Touched avoid the Wringer, despite the fact that Suna is within Sirius borders.
ref: 绞肉机（The Wringer）原名尤利西斯前哨站(Ulysses Outpost)，但如今除了几块锈迹斑斑的破旧铭牌外，已没有任何事物能让站内居民想起这个名字。这里曾是旧帝国的偏远科研设施，随着帝国黄金时代结束后预算削减日益加剧，维持设施运转的资金逐渐枯竭，最终遭到废弃。此后，这个空间站被小罪犯和独行者占据——这些人无论来自哪个星域都不受欢迎，却又不够格或不愿成为海盗。无需多言，绞肉机 绝非什么宜居之地，很少有人会自愿前来。就连受触者(The Touched)都避而远之，尽管苏娜(Suna)星区仍在天狼星疆域之内。

src: This bar is always full of people, some crowding around the many holovid pillars to watch the fights in the tournament, others drinking their sorrows away if their contestant was unlucky. The air is buzzing with excitement, and it's hard to make oneself heard over the din. For this reason, orders are placed through terminals projected onto the table surface, and drinks are served from a small dispenser in the middle of the table. Obviously, this establishment is making a lot of money.
ref: 这个酒吧总是挤满了人，一些人聚集在许多全息柱子周围观看锦标赛的比赛，另一些人则在他们的参赛者运气不佳的情况下喝下他们的悲伤。空气中充满了兴奋的嗡嗡声，很难让人在嘈杂的声音中听到自己的声音。出于这个原因，订单通过投射在桌子表面的终端下单，饮料从桌子中央的一个小自动售货机上提供。显然，这家机构赚了很多钱。

src: Trevis Cloister is one of those places where young military personnel are stationed to get some field experience under their belt before being sent to the more dangerous systems. Many of them will complain at each other in the bar about how bored they are and how they hope to get a real position sometime soon, but the more experienced soldiers know that few posts are as enviable as the ones on Trevis.
ref: Trevis Cloister是年轻军事人员驻扎的地方之一，在被送往更危险的星系之前，他们会在那里获得一些实地经验。他们中的许多人会在酒吧里互相抱怨自己有多无聊，多么希望不久就能找到一个真正的职位，但经验更丰富的士兵知道，很少有职位像Trevis 的职位那样令人羡慕。

src: Trincea is one of the most heavily populated worlds in Dvaered space. As such it is a rather attractive planet for Warlords to fight over, so the laws of the planet are prone to frequent change. The citizens have grown used to it, though, adapting to new legislation as a matter of course. By Dvaered standards, they're exceptionally flexible in their thinking.
ref: Trincea 是戴瓦德(Dvaered)势力范围内人口最密集的星球之一。因此它成为军阀们争夺的诱人目标，导致该行星的法律经常频繁变更。尽管公民们已逐渐习惯这种状况，将适应新法规视为理所当然。以戴瓦德(Dvaered)标准来看，他们的思维方式具有超乎寻常的灵活性。

src: Many people who live in the Empire think of the Dvaered as unsophisticated, brawny louts who spend all day down in the mines and all night picking fights with each other. This is a stereotype, and it's hardly a fair description of Dvaered society as a whole, but it happens to be absolutely accurate when it comes to the Dvaereds on Utsuwa. The colony on this planet is a full-time mining operation, and all who live on Utsuwa work in the mining industry or its peripherals. Needless to say, House Dvaered gets a significant amount of its raw resources from here.
ref: 帝国居民常将戴瓦德(Dvaered)人视作粗鲁蛮横的莽夫——终日泡在矿井里，夜夜斗殴生事。这虽是刻板印象，远不能代表整个戴瓦德社会，却精准描述了宇津轮(Utsuwa)星上的戴瓦德群体。该行星殖民地实为全天候采矿基地，所有居民都从事矿业或其周边产业。毋庸置疑，戴瓦德家族(House Dvaered)的大量原材料都源自此地。

src:
Varia is a Dvaered world, so it can't be called lush or relaxing. But it's the next best thing. The climate on Varia is as close to old Earth's as makes no difference, and the inhabitants of this world typically lead healthy, long lives. In fact, the planet is so nice that some feel it is wasted on the Dvaered, who misuse the bounty the planet offers for their crude, destructive forms of entertainment.
The headquarters of Schafer & Kane Industries and their main fabrication plants are also located on Varia, which helps contribute greatly to the prosperity of the local population. Following traditional Dvaered design, S&K Industries prioritize function over form, leading to very practical buildings that further clash with the planets natural beauty.
ref: Varia是戴瓦德(Dvaered)世界，因此不能称其为郁郁葱葱或令人放松。但它已是最接近理想的选择。Varia的气候与古地球相差无几，居民通常健康长寿。事实上，这个星球如此美好，以至于有人认为被戴瓦德(Dvaered)人浪费了——他们滥用星球馈赠的资源，用于粗野破坏性的娱乐形式。谢弗-凯恩工业总部及其主要制造厂也坐落于Varia，极大促进了当地繁荣。遵循戴瓦德(Dvaered)传统设计理念，斯卡纳和凯恩(S&K)工业优先考虑功能而非形式，建造出实用至上的建筑，与星球自然美景形成鲜明对比。

src: Vennis is a planet with characteristics quite close to the Earth Standard. Its gravity, surface area, day-night cycle and annual cycle closely match that of old Earth. It would be a highly suitable planet to live on, were it not for the highly acidic atmosphere. House Sirius has recently settled a dome colony here, with the intent of eventually terraforming the planet to a high class residential world. It will be many cycles before this ideal is be realized but the inhabitants of Vennis persevere.
ref:
维尼斯(Vennis)是颗各项指标接近地球标准( Earth Standard)的行星，其重力、表面积、昼夜周期与年周期均与古地球高度吻合。若非大气层具有强酸性，本可成为极佳宜居星球。天狼星家族(House Sirius)近期在此建立了穹顶殖民地，计划最终将其改造为高端住宅星球。
虽距理想实现尚需多个周期，维尼斯的居民们仍在坚持奋斗。

src: Wellen is a good example of how the individual planetary management policy of the Empire can go wrong. Started as a prestigious project, the world was to be a perfect society with good housing and facilities for everyone, lots of greenery and no pollution. However, the goals were too ambitious, the funds too short and the leadership inadequate. Today Wellen is a slum of run-down, oftentimes half-finished, buildings.
ref: Wellen 是一个很好的例子，说明帝国的个人行星管理政策可能会出错。从一个享有盛誉的项目开始，世界将成为一个完美的社会，每个人都有良好的住房和设施，大量的绿色植物，没有污染。然而，目标太雄心勃勃，资金太少，领导层不足。今天，Wellen 是一个贫民窟，到处都是破旧的、往往是半成品的建筑。

src: The Soromid have more or less stabilized as a genetically modified offshoot from humanity, but that doesn't mean research into genetic alteration isn't still ongoing. Wonclok hosts one of the largest bioresearch centres in Soromid space. Many of the commercially sold gene treatments were developed here, and being a researcher on Wonclok carries a lot of prestige with the Soromid.
ref: 索洛米德人(Soromid)作为人类的基因改造分支已基本稳定，但这并不意味着基因改造研究就此止步。旺克洛克(Wonclok)拥有索洛米德星域内规模最大的生物研究中心之一，市面上许多商用基因疗法均诞生于此。在索洛米德社会中，能成为旺克洛克的研究人员享有极高声望。

src: A bit of an odd planet, Zaals has a rotational period almost (but not quite) identical to its orbital period. One day on Zaals lasts many, many cycles. The Soromid habitation here has been built on the side facing the sun, where conditions are still acceptable. It's actually the second iteration of the settlement, as the first iteration has begun to slip into the dark side. The current settlement is predicted to stay in the light for another forty cycles.
ref: Zaals是一个有点奇怪的行星，它的自转周期几乎(但不完全)与它的轨道周期相同。在Zaals上的一天会持续很多很多个周期。这里的索洛米德(Soromid)居所建在面向太阳的一侧，那里的条件仍然可以接受。这实际上是定居点的第二次迭代，因为第一次迭代已经开始滑入黑暗面。据预测，目前的沉降还将持续40个周期。

src: Zabween outpost is an old station. It was first created as an outpost to fight piracy but with the destruction of the Haven it has settled into a more traditional role. It presently functions as a largely commercial station, trading in many commodities, while also keeping on eye on the Soromid border. It keeps a museum with all sorts of ships and weapons that were used in the final fight against Haven.
ref: Zabween前哨是个老空间站。它最初是作为打击海盗的前哨而创建的，但随着避风港的摧毁，它已经成为一个更传统的角色。它目前主要是一个商业站，交易许多商品，同时也密切关注索洛米德(Soromid)的边境。它保存着一个博物馆，里面有在与港湾的最后战斗中使用的各种船只和武器。

src: What is beautiful is often dangerous but sometimes it also works the other way around. The spaceport bar on Anubis has a view over a ravine in the planet's surface and the radioactive storms that frequently rage through it are quite a sight to behold. Only offworlders appreciate it though, most of the locals know how unpleasant it is to have to work in such raging, radioactive conditions.
ref: 美丽的东西往往是危险的，但有时它也会反过来发挥作用。阿努比斯上的太空港酒吧可以俯瞰行星表面的一个峡谷，经常在那里肆虐的放射性风暴是一个相当可观的景象。然而，只有外来者才会欣赏它，大多数当地人都知道不得不在如此恶劣的放射性条件下工作是多么不愉快。

src: Beene is rich in all sorts of common minerals, so the Soromid are using this world the same way anyone would: as a source of raw materials. The elements mined here are processed into standard packages that are used by the Soromid bioships. This supply of minerals means Beene is quite an important strategic location for Soromid fleets.
ref: Beene 富含各种常见的矿物，所以索洛米德(Soromid)人和任何人都一样地利用这个世界:作为原材料的来源。这里开采的元素被加工成标准包装，供索洛米德(Soromid)生物船使用。矿产的供应意味着Beene 对索洛米德(Soromid)舰队来说是一个相当重要的战略位置。

src:
Bolero has quickly become one of the Empire's most successful planets due to its recent growth. The population is prosperous and successful, and the planet's conditions are mild. Although it is still treated as something of a backwater due to its location, it is becoming increasingly important in Imperial politics.
A lot of Bolero's popularity comes from its Earth-like climate, giving a reassuring sense of nostalgia to all those who were able to visit Earth before the Incident. However, some people avoid it for exactly the same reason…
ref:
由于最近的增长，Bolero 迅速成为帝国最成功的行星之一。人口繁荣和成功，地球的条件是温和的。尽管由于它的地理位置，它仍然被视为死水，但它在帝国政治中正变得越来越重要。
它的受欢迎程度很大程度上来自于它与地球相似的气候，让所有在事件发生前能够访问地球的人都有一种令人安心的怀旧之感。然而，一些人出于完全相同的原因而避免使用…

src: Dawn's bar has a rustic feel to it; the locals have made a point of keeping the style close to what was the prevalent design in the early expansion era. Other than that, this bar doesn't have much to set it apart from others. The noise, the smell, and the drunks are features that are commonplace throughout the galaxy.
ref: 黎明酒吧有一种质朴的感觉；当地人一直在努力保持风格，接近早期扩张时代的流行设计。除此之外，这家酒吧没有太多区别于其他酒吧的地方。噪音、气味和醉汉是整个银河系常见的特征。

src:
Dvaer Prime is the capital world of all of Dvaered space, the world on which the Old Empire granted House Dvaered its status as a Great House, and the world after which its founders chose to name their people.
However, iconic though the planet may be, it is of little actual consequence. At best it is fought over jealously by the Dvaered Warlords, who consider ownership of the world a matter of great prestige; otherwise there is nothing that sets Dvaer Prime apart from other planets. After all, the decisions are all made in Dvaered High Command, which floats in high orbit over Dvaer Prime.
ref:
戴瓦德(Dvaered)母星是所有戴瓦德(Dvaered)空间的首都世界，旧帝国在这个世界上授予DVAUE作为伟大的家族的地位，它的创建者们选择以这个世界来命名他们的人民。
然而，尽管这颗行星可能是标志性的，但它几乎没有实际影响。在最好的情况下，它是由分散的军阀们嫉妒地争夺的，他们认为世界的所有权是一个非常有威望的问题；否则，没有什么能把达瓦尔总理与其他星球区分开来。毕竟，所有的决定都是由戴瓦德(Dvaered)最高司令部做出的，该司令部在戴瓦德(Dvaered)主星空的高轨道上漂浮。

src: This bar is full of shouting and arguments, with the occasional fist-fight, all based on matters that most laymen find difficult to understand, let alone pick a side on. There is a large quantity of food and drink spilled on the floors as a result of this and the harried staff seem relieved when you make sure to avoid provoking anyone or making eye contact.
ref: 这家酒吧充满了大喊大叫和争吵，偶尔还会发生拳击，所有这些都是基于大多数门外汉难以理解的事情，更不用说选择哪一方了。由于这一点，大量的食物和饮料洒在了地板上，当你确保避免激怒任何人或进行眼神接触时，忙碌的工作人员似乎松了一口气。

src: Inios Monastery is something like a border guard between Sirius and Dvaered controlled territories. Though officially not a military complex, Inios does garrison far more combat capable ships that one might expect of a commercial station. Whenever the Dvaered send in skirmish fleets to try the Sirius defences, it is Inios Monastery that sends them on their way home.
ref: Inios Monastery就像是天狼星和戴瓦德(Dvaered)控制区之间的边境守卫。虽然名义上不是军事设施，但Inios驻扎的战舰数量远超商业空间站的预期。每当戴瓦德(Dvaered)派出小规模舰队试探天狼星的防御时，总是Inios Monastery将它们驱逐回老家。

src: Madria is one of the few immigration worlds in Sirius space. Colonists from the Frontier constantly trickle into Esker, and they all end up here. The new arrivals are immediately converted and incorporated into the Shaira echelon, which is why that group is over-represented on this world. Only after several cycles of life on Madria do the immigrants get permission to move to other Sirius worlds or serve in the Sirius military.
ref: Madria 是天狼星空间中为数不多的移民星球之一。来自边境的殖民者不断涌入埃斯克尔，他们最终都来到了这里。新来的人立即被转换并并入夏拉梯队，这就是为什么这个群体在这个世界上代表过多。只有在Madria 上生活了几个周期后，移民才能获准搬到其他天狼星世界或在天狼星军队中服役。

src: The Vigilante Cantina is the place to do business on New Xantusia. Bounties and other mercenary offers are shown in real-time on the central holo-display of the cantina. Many mercenaries and bounty hunters spend their time enjoying the food and drink while keeping an eye out for a good job. Every so often a popular job will cause a spur of activity as people scramble to complete it before others.
ref: 义务警员坎蒂纳是在新赞图西亚做生意的地方。赏金和其他雇佣兵的提议在酒吧的中央全息显示器上实时显示。许多雇佣兵和赏金猎人在享受食物和饮料的同时，也在寻找一份好工作。当人们争先恐后地完成一项受欢迎的工作时，它往往会刺激人们的活动。

src: Hurriedly built to defend the Empire from the Collective, the Omega Enclave has observed countless battles fought in its sector. Its presence has helped stem the flow of Collective drones into Empire space. Due to the constant attacks, the construction of the base is a mismatch of reinforced panels and salvaged ship parts, contrasting greatly with the standardized designs of most Imperial stations.
ref: Omega飞地仓促建造是为了保卫帝国免受集体的侵害，它在其地区目睹了无数次战斗。它的存在有助于阻止Collective无人机进入帝国太空。由于不断的袭击，基地的建造是加固面板和打捞船只部件的不匹配，与大多数帝国空间站的标准化设计形成鲜明对比。

src: Phosarrus is a pristine civilian world inhabited by the Soromid. The biosphere is very mild even by non-modified standards, so for the Soromid it is a rare gem. The population is estimated at an impressive one billion, but despite this the planet's ecological system remains in balance. This is in no small thanks to Soromid bioengineering - modified microbiological and plant life help keep the balance from breaking down.
ref: Phosarrus 是索洛米德(Soromid)人居住的一个原始的平民世界。即使以未经修改的标准来看，生物圈也是非常温和的，所以对于索洛米德(Soromid)人来说，它是一颗稀有的宝石。据估计，地球上的人口达到了令人印象深刻的10亿，但尽管如此，地球的生态系统仍然保持着平衡。这在很大程度上要归功于索洛米德(Soromid)生物工程--改良的微生物和植物生命有助于防止平衡被打破。

src: Sabe and Anya are a pair of planets tidally locked to each other, rotating around their shared centre of gravity. Sabe is the centre of the Thurian government, housing the largest population of both uploaded and biological Thurions, acting as the de-facto capital. The majority of the planet's surface is untouched, as virtually all its inhabitants reside in the multitude of arcologies spread across its surface.
ref: Sabe和Anya是一对相互潮汐锁定的行星，围绕着他们共同的重心旋转。萨贝是瑟里昂(Thurion)政府的中心，拥有最多的上传和生物瑟里昂(Thurion)人口，是事实上的首都。地球表面的大部分都是原封不动的，因为几乎所有的居民都居住在遍布地球表面的众多古生物中。

src: The bar boasts a diversity of local drinks with in-depth explanations of their origins and histories. You would swear that a couple are the same drink with different names, but you're pretty sure that if you point it out you'll start a riot. The people seem friendly enough, but they all seem to keep their distance with newcomers.
ref: 这家酒吧以当地饮料的多样性而自豪，并深入解释了它们的起源和历史。你会发誓说一对情侣是同一种饮料，但名字不同，但你非常肯定，如果你指出这一点，你会引发一场骚乱。人们看起来很友好，但他们似乎都与新来的人保持距离。

src: Ostensibly a 'research station' this rickety station is in fact a gambling den and smuggling outpost for the criminal underbelly in Za'lek space. There is a diverse array of goods available to the captain who is carefully incurious about the origins. Scientists looking into illegal research (what little there is in Za'lek space), 'private military contractors', 'free traders', it's all here.
ref: 表面上是一个"研究站"，这个摇摇欲坠的站实际上是扎列克(Za'lek)星域犯罪团伙的赌博巢穴和走私前哨基地。有各种各样的货物提供给船长谁是谨慎的不好奇的来源。研究非法研究的科学家(在扎列克(Za'lek)星域很少)，"私人军事承包商"，"自由贸易者"，都在这里。

src: The Crucible is a hive of scum and villainy. All sorts of illicit activities go on here including gambling, drug dealing and money laundering. Though the station is within Soromid controlled territory, the Pirates have an interest in keeping the station online so they make sure the local Soromid forces have more important things to worry about than shutting it down. The Soromid also seem to play into this game, as they are interested in concentrating the villainy, least it spread to nearby Soromid planets.
ref: The Crucible 是人渣和恶棍的聚集地。这里进行着各种非法活动，包括赌博、毒品交易和洗钱。虽然空间站在索洛米德(Soromid)控制的领土内，但海盗们有兴趣保持空间站的在线，所以他们确保当地索罗米德部队有比关闭它更重要的事情要担心。索洛米德(Soromid)人似乎也参与了这场游戏，因为他们感兴趣的是集中恶棍，至少它会扩散到附近的索洛米德(Soromid)行星。

src:
When the thirteenth colony ship, Yamato Nadeshiko, arrived at Tori, it was sterile - in spite of the planet's abundant supply of both water and carbon. But the colonists' introduction of Earth flora was successful beyond expectations, and within a century the planet had acquired a fully functional ecosystem; today much of the world's surface is covered by nature, a state the inhabitants of Tori have maintained since.
Though Tori's economic potential remains largely untapped, the thriving tourist industry largely compensates.
ref: 当第十三艘殖民飞船'大和抚子号(Yamato Nadeshiko)'抵达托里(Tori)时，尽管该星球富含水和碳元素，却是一片荒芜。但殖民者从地球引进的植物群落取得了超乎预期的成功，仅用不到一个世纪就形成了完整的生态系统；如今星球表面大部分区域都被自然植被覆盖，托里居民一直保持着这种生态平衡。尽管托里的经济潜力尚未充分开发，但蓬勃发展的旅游业在很大程度上弥补了这一不足。

src: There is literally a world of difference between Thymo and Turawee. Unlike its barren cousin, Turawee is a lush, comfortable world that was never charted even during the Third Growth. The Soromid, having few natural M-class planets at their disposal, take good care of this world. While most other factions would struggle with the trade-off between prosperity and ecology, the Soromid have managed to strike a perfect balance. Turawee may be the only inhabited planet in the galaxy whose environment has not been significantly altered in any way by its occupants.
ref: Thymo和Turawee之间确实存在着天壤之别。与贫瘠的表亲不同，Turawee是一个郁郁葱葱、舒适的世界，即使在第三次生长期间也从未被绘制出来。索洛米德(Soromid)人，几乎没有天然的M级行星可供支配，他们很好地照顾着这个世界。当大多数其他派系在繁荣和生态之间的权衡中苦苦挣扎时，索洛米德(Soromid)家族却设法取得了完美的平衡。Turawee可能是银河系中唯一一颗环境没有被居住者以任何方式显着改变的有人居住的行星。

src: Pilots are advised to wear air-sealed suits when visiting Beene's bar. The planet's atmosphere can cause serious problems for normal humans and the Soromid haven't bothered installing decontamination filters for the local population. As such, having a drink in Beene's bar is a bit of an ordeal. It's one of the less popular places among traders looking for a drink.
ref: 飞行员被建议在访问Beene的酒吧时穿上气密服。地球的大气层会给普通人带来严重的问题，索洛米德(Soromid)人并没有费心为当地居民安装去污过滤器。因此，在比内的酒吧里喝一杯是一种磨难。这是在寻找饮料的商人中不太受欢迎的地方之一。

src: Ever the optimists, the people of Draconis Omega have decorated their spaceport bar with displays of past Imperial power, portraits of former Emperors and charts that show the size of the Empire when it was at its peak. It's certainly a good lesson in history and it's clear that the inhabitants truly believe that the good times will one day return.
ref: 作为乐观主义者，Draconis Omega的人们用展示过去帝国权力的展品、前皇帝的肖像和展示帝国鼎盛时期大小的图表来装饰他们的航天酒吧。这当然是历史上的一个很好的教训，显然，居民们真的相信美好的时光总有一天会回来的。

src: Halir's bar has everything the weary traveller could hope for, from drinks to data uplink terminals to per-table sound dampening fields and music generators. In short it is a luxurious place, which is largely due to Halir's long history of economic success. Anything you can't find in the bar you can find in the pleasure district, which is just a single tube station away.
ref: Halir的酒吧拥有疲惫的旅客所希望的一切，从饮料到数据上行终端，再到按桌的声音抑制场和音乐发生器。简而言之，这是一个奢华的地方，这在很大程度上归功于哈利尔悠久的经济成功历史。任何你在酒吧找不到的东西，你都可以在游乐区找到，该游乐区仅一个地铁站。

src: There are four main portals leading into and out of this spaceport bar. One leads to the spaceport facility. The second leads to the central public transit hub in this area of the metroplex that spans much of the continent. The third leads directly to the local commercial node, and the final portal is connected to the emergency service network, a separate infrastructure completely dedicated to emergency vehicles.
ref: 有四个主要入口进出这个太空港酒吧。一条通向太空港设施。第二条通往横跨非洲大陆大部分地区的大都会区的中央公共交通枢纽。第三个直接通向本地商业节点，最后一个门户连接到紧急服务网络，这是一个完全专用于紧急车辆的独立基础设施。

src: Like most of the station, the bar is directly built into the gambling complex, with a constant buzz of noises from the different slot machines and game tables. Station staff wiz around the floor bestowing complementary drinks to newcomers and heavy gamblers alike. You can feel how the entire ambience is designed to encourage excessive behaviour in a very carefully planned mechanical way.
ref: 像空间站的大多数地方一样，酒吧直接建在博彩综合体中，不同的老虎机和游戏桌不断发出嗡嗡声。空间站工作人员在大厅里四处走动，为新来的人和重度赌徒提供补充饮料。你可以感觉到整个氛围是如何被设计成以非常精心策划的机械方式鼓励过度行为的。

src: The bar connects and sprawls through the 4 different station wings, acting as the de facto meeting place for connecting and meeting people. Originally called the Santoros Dining and Drinks, it was renamed along with the station to simply the Forum, given its important functionality as one of the cores of the station.
