Provided by many of the guilds, the bar features over 17,000 different drinks, making it all but impossible to find ones you truly enjoy, but that doesn't stop everyone from keeping on trying.
ref: 酒吧通过4个不同的空间站侧翼连接和延伸，充当了联系和会见人们的事实上的聚会场所。它最初被称为桑托罗斯(Santoros)餐饮，由于其作为空间站核心之一的重要功能，它与空间站一起更名为简单的论坛。这家酒吧由许多协会提供，提供超过17,000种不同的饮料，因此几乎不可能找到你真正喜欢的饮料，但这并不妨碍每个人继续尝试。

src: For a world as nice as Phosarrus, the spaceport bar is a surprisingly simple affair. The reason for this is that the planet's civilian offworld mass transit is handled via a different terminal, so the only people who use this section of the spaceport are traders and civilians who own their own ships. Lavish recreational facilities would be wasted on them, the thought must have been.
ref: 对于一个像Phosarrus这样美好的世界来说，太空港酒吧是一件出人意料的简单事情。这样做的原因是，地球上的民用外世界公共交通是通过不同的航站楼处理的，所以使用这一段航天港的唯一人是拥有自己船只的商人和平民。奢华的娱乐设施将浪费在他们身上，想必是这样想的。

src: Although not well publicized due to the nature of many deals going on at the location, Shangris Station is infamous for being a place where one can acquire all sorts of outfits, as long as you don't ask or care about where it has come from. There is a constant coming and going of ships of all types with people from all walks of life. You can see hardened thugs and criminals, fairly normal looking pilots, and even what looks like poorly disguised Imperial bureaucrats walking around the station. It seems like pretty much everything goes as long as you don't call too much attention to yourself or stir too much trouble.
ref: 虽然由于该地点正在进行的许多交易的性质而没有得到很好的宣传，但香格里斯站是一个臭名昭著的地方，你可以在那里购买各种各样的装备，只要你不问或不关心它来自哪里。各种类型的船只不断来往，各行各业的人都有。你可以看到顽固的暴徒和罪犯，看起来相当正常的飞行员，甚至看起来像是伪装得很差的帝国官僚在空间站周围走来走去。似乎只要你不引起太多的注意或引起太多的麻烦，一切都会顺利进行。

src: As you would expect, the bar is the heart of organizing all the illegal deals going on. The constant movement of individuals and the constant ambient noise makes it hard to keep an eye out on your surroundings, which you feel is fairly important to getting out of here in one piece. Every so often a deal goes wrong, ending in yelling, brawls, and sometimes worse outcomes. However, no matter the commotion, the veterans and bartenders do not seem to flinch, seems like this happens all the time.
ref: 正如你所预料的那样，酒吧是组织所有非法交易的核心。个人的不断移动和持续的环境噪音使你很难密切关注你的周围环境，你觉得这对完好无损地离开这里相当重要。有时，一笔交易会出错，最终以大喊大叫、斗殴告终，有时还会出现更糟糕的结果。然而，无论骚动，退伍军人和调酒师似乎并没有退缩，似乎这种情况一直都在发生。

src: Warden's End exists as a place for less-than-legal wares to be bought and sold. Known as one of the few truly "free" markets, many of the less reputable merchants in the galaxy come here to peddle their wares. Many a merchant has gained - and lost - a fortune here. The station itself is made out of the welded-together ships of merchants who became destitute.
ref: 守望者终点站(Warden's End)是进行非法商品交易的灰色地带。作为少数真正'自由'的市场之一，银河系中许多声名狼藉的商人都来此兜售货物。无数商人在这里一夜暴富，又转眼倾家荡产。空间站本身是由破产商人的飞船焊接拼凑而成。

src:
Making the most of Bolero's similarity with Earth, the bar here is an old-Earth style pub, with a low ceiling, warm beer and good food. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, the clients are all polite and cheerful and the bouncers barely loom at all.
There seems to be relatively few locals mixed in with the patrons; the majority of people appear to be temporary visitors, either arriving for vacations or business trips.
ref:
这里的酒吧充分利用了波莱罗与地球的相似之处，是一家古老的地球风格的酒吧，天花板低，啤酒温，食物美味。气氛热烈而热情，客户都很有礼貌和开朗，几乎看不到保镖。
与顾客混在一起的当地人似乎相对较少；大多数人似乎是临时游客，要么是来度假的，要么是来出差的。

src: Burnan doesn't have a separate spaceport bar in the way many other worlds do. The spaceport bar and the main spaceport hall are, instead, one and the same thing. There are exits to terminals on all sides and the central area is dominated by an island of service interfaces and counters. There is an elevated area that has tables for visitors to sit down at, where they won't get in the way of the bustle and traffic of the main floor.
ref: Burnan 没有像许多其他世界那样的单独的太空港酒吧。相反，太空港酒吧和主太空港大厅是一回事。四面都有航站楼的出口，中心区主要是一个服务接口和柜台的孤岛。有一个高架区域，有供参观者坐下的桌子，他们不会阻碍主楼的熙熙攘攘和交通。

src: New Haven is a planet located beyond the boundaries of law and justice. Founded by Bartax the Great, one of the most successful pirates to ever live, after Haven was annihilated. The planet's atmosphere is highly toxic and has high levels of radiation outside of the stronghold. These very features are what made the Empire classify it as uninhabitable, as it lacks strategic resources necessary to justify the cost of terraforming. Its distance from other civilized worlds affords it protection from prying eyes.
ref: New Haven是一个位于法律和正义边界之外的星球。由巴塔克斯大帝创立，他是有史以来最成功的海盗之一，在港湾被歼灭后。这颗行星的大气具有剧毒，在据点外有高水平的辐射。正是这些特点使帝国将其归类为不适合居住，因为它缺乏必要的战略资源来证明土地改造的成本是合理的。它与其他文明世界的距离为它提供了免受窥探的保护。

src: Tucked away in the shadow of P-8493, Pirate's Cove is a den of swashbucklers and independent privateers from the southern region of Sirius Space. Not directly affiliated with any of the main pirate clans, the place is a chaotic mess where strength and cunning is the rule of law. The inhabitants live in a sprawling construction extending from the space port, full of small winding paths resembling a labyrinth more than a city. The constant electromagnetic interference from all the devices makes it so one can not rely on advanced navigation hardware, and it all comes down to memorization and use of crude maps. Outside the sprawling city, the planet is lush and wild, home to hundreds if not thousands of illegally obtained species that have escaped or been released. It is rumoured that some man-eating beasts also lurk in the forests, but people disappearing through misfortunes and murders is a more likely explanation.
ref: 隐藏在P-8493的阴影下的海盗湾是来自天狼星空间南部地区的虚张声势的人和独立的私人船只的窝点。这个地方没有直接隶属于任何主要的海盗部族，这个地方是一个混乱的地方，力量和狡猾是法治。居民们住在从太空港延伸出来的庞大建筑里，到处都是曲折的小路，看起来更像是一座迷宫，而不是一座城市。来自所有设备的持续电磁干扰使得人们不能依赖先进的导航硬件，而这一切都归结为记忆和使用原始星图。在这座不断扩张的城市之外，这颗星球郁郁葱葱、荒无人烟，是数以百计、甚至几千种非法获得的物种的家园，这些物种已经逃脱或被释放。有传言说，森林里也潜伏着一些吃人的野兽，但更有可能的解释是，人们因不幸和谋杀而消失。

src:
Although having a very low hospitality index due to the thin atmosphere and abundance of damaging space dust, Old King Cole's moon Sanchez was colonized due to being located on a trade lane. While not being very prosperous, it grew and expanded over time. When the Incident struck, Sanchez was lucky to be shielded from the expanding Nebula by being in Old King Cole's shadow. Despite not being destroyed outright, the severe intensity of the radiation ended up killing nearly all that were unable to emigrate to safer territory. Out of sheer necessity the few survivors were able to mainly shield themselves by digging into the core of the moon, using extreme pharmacological treatments to survive their apocalypse. Eventually scavengers and pirates found the station again, and a unique alliance was struck, leading to the creation of the Dreamer Pirate Clan.
Through piracy, Sanchez has reached a prosperity it never had before Incident. Although still far from a rich planet, it hosts many refugees from nearby systems and criminals fleeing from more civilized society. Given the frail balance one would think that this would lead to an inevitable doom, however, heavy use of narcotics and a communal mindset avoids most serious conflicts and allows the society at Sanchez to be relatively stable.
ref:
尽管由于稀薄大气层和有害太空尘埃导致宜居指数极低，老国王科尔(Old King Cole)的卫星桑切斯(Sanchez)仍因位于贸易航线上而被殖民。虽从未繁荣过，这个殖民地仍随时间推移逐渐扩张。当大灾变(The Incident)来袭时，桑切斯幸运地因处于老国王科尔的阴影中而躲过了星云扩张的冲击。虽未直接毁灭，但强烈的辐射仍导致几乎所有未能移民到安全区域的人丧生。幸存者们出于生存需要，通过挖掘月球核心构筑掩体，配合极端药物疗法挺过了这场末日。
最终，拾荒者与海盗重新发现了这个空间站，并结成独特同盟，由此诞生了梦想家海盗氏族(Dreamer Pirate Clan)。通过海盗活动，桑切斯获得了大灾变前从未有过的繁荣。虽仍算不上富裕星球，这里却收容着来自邻近星系的难民和逃离文明社会的罪犯。表面脆弱的平衡本应导致社会崩溃，但毒品泛滥和集体主义思维反而避免了严重冲突，使桑切斯社会维持着相对稳定。

src: Whether you're looking to get black out drunk, get into fights with the locals, or do shady business, the Shangris Bar is the place to be. It is a tumultuous place where it is impossible to keep track of what is going on at any given time. Lots of shady characters can be seen all over and every so often a fight breaks out to the cheering of onlookers. However, it does seem like there are some unspoken rules and even fights end shortly and get cleaned up so quick that you would have doubted there had been one in the first place.
ref: 无论你是想喝得酩酊大醉，还是想和当地人打架，还是想做不光彩的生意，Shangris 酒吧都是你的好去处。这是一个混乱的地方，在任何给定的时间都不可能跟踪正在发生的事情。许多阴暗的人物随处可见，不时会有打斗在旁观者的欢呼声中爆发。然而，看起来确实有一些潜规则，甚至战斗很快就会结束，很快就会被清理干净，以至于你会怀疑一开始就有这样的规则。

src: The Knot bar is located at the core of the station, where the original hangars where. As the space station developed, the hangars lost direct access to space, losing their original purpose, and eventually were transformed into the lively atmosphere you find in front of you. Most of the patrons are engineers, both Za'lek and Society alike, who engage in lively conversations on extremely technical details over which they get easily worked up over.
ref: 结酒吧位于空间站的核心区域，原机库所在地。随着空间站的发展，机库逐渐失去了直接通往太空的通道，失去了原有功能，最终被改造成眼前这片热闹的场所。顾客多为工程师，既有扎列克(Za'lek)人也有学会成员，他们就极其技术性的细节展开激烈讨论，常常为此争得面红耳赤。

src: Vorca has long been the main base of operations of small time gangsters and crooks, but it didn't grow into a serious Pirate stronghold until the Dvaered Revolts. In that time of tension and discord, many decided to turn their backs on the Empire entirely and eke out a new life, accruing wealth by taking it from others. Those who survived in that line of work flocked to Vorca. Now the planet is host to an impressive fleet of private, more-or-less similarly aligned ships.
ref: Vorca 长期以来都是小规模帮派分子的主要据点，但直到戴瓦德(Dvaered)叛乱时期才发展成为真正的海盗要塞。在那个充满紧张与纷争的年代，许多人决定彻底背弃帝国，通过掠夺他人财富来维持新生活。那些在劫掠行当中幸存下来的人纷纷涌向 Vorca。如今该星球拥有令人印象深刻的私人舰队，这些舰船大体上保持着同盟关系。

src: The Slop and Grill is one of the nastiest taverns in the universe. The food and drink don't help matters. Most of it is brewed on New Haven and wouldn't pass any minimal health insurance tests anywhere. Some of the booze even doubles as ship fuel, in times of need. The clients are also deep space thugs, pirates, black marketeers, mercenaries and other shady folk that insist on keeping the ground coated with blood and broken teeth. Not a great place to bring your family.
ref: Slop and Grill是宇宙中最肮脏的酒馆之一。食物和饮料无助于解决问题。其中大部分是在New Haven酿造的，在任何地方都不会通过任何最低限度的医疗保险测试。在需要的时候，一些酒甚至可以兼作船用燃料。客户也是深空暴徒、海盗、黑市商人、雇佣兵和其他阴暗的人，他们坚持让地面沾满鲜血和破碎的牙齿。不是带家人去的好地方。

src: The average space pilot would, when walking into a Pirate bar, expect utter chaos, fraught with boozing, gambling, violence and narcotic substances. This is an expectation the bar on Vorca does not live up to. As a matter of fact the establishment is quite tightly policed by henchmen of the Clan leaders and, as such, is one of the most orderly places within several jumps. The bar serves as neutral ground among the Pirates themselves and a meeting place for those who, for whatever reason, want to solicit their aid.
ref: 当走进海盗酒吧时，一般的太空飞行员会想到一片混乱，里面充斥着酗酒、赌博、暴力和毒品。这是对沃卡的标准达不到的期望。事实上，当权派由氏族首领的追随者严密监管，因此，在几次跳跃中，它是最有秩序的地方之一。这个酒吧是海盗们之间的中立场所，也是那些出于任何原因想要寻求他们帮助的人的聚会场所。
